tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba brtag pa gcig pa le'u bco lnga pa sh+lau ka stong dang nyi shu lnga pa'o// rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ḍā ki ni badz+ra pa n+dza ra ma hā tan tra ra dza kalpa nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa/ kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' bem bcas dwangs pa dang / /go skabs med dang 'byed pa dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje gzhi gnas khang / /sems can khams dang yid 'ong dang / /sems can snod dang 'jig rten dang / /sa dang sa 'og bar snang dang / /yid dang lus dang ngag dang ni/ /gcig la gnyis dang mkha' bde dang / /drug dang lnga dang drug gnyis dang / /zhi dang skye 'gro rnams dang ni/ /gcig gis nyi shur ma tshang dang / /khams gsum ma lus pa dang ni/ /pha dang bu dang ma mo dang / /phyi rol dang ni nang dang ngam/ /btsun mo kun dang chos dang ni/ /thams cad las dang bdag med dang / /'bras bu rgyu dang bya ba zhes/ /bsgrub bya sgrub thabs rdo rje dang / /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /chos kyi dbyings dang ma byung dang / /nam mkha' mkha' dang rang dbyings dang / /bdag med pa dang bdag ces dang / /dngos po med dang dngos med min/ /bde ba can dang gru gsum dang / /a skyes dang ni skyon bral dang / /rdul bral dang ni sdig bcom dang / /rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin dang / /mthar ni zhi ba'i bde rig dang / /gsang ba mchog dang dgyes pa la/ /sangs rgyas kun khyab sems dpa' ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /lha yi bdag po gcig pu nyid/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje/ /las ni dkyil 'khor lnga gsungs pa/ /rdo rje can dang phan pa'i dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gzi brjid nyid/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /rta bdun rgyal po lnga pa 'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/

/dkar mo rkun ma ro langs ma/ /ghasma ri dang puk+ka si/ /ri khrod gdol pa g.yung mo'o/ /rdo rje phan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /skam pa zhags pa ma nyid dang / /dol ma dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /me tog ma sogs mtshams kyi char/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyi lag ma dang mar me ma/ /rin chen sgron ma glog lag ma/ /lā s+yā+e la sogs mtshams char ro/ /pad ma chos 'byung lcag sgrog dang / /'khyud ma gar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /gling bu ma sogs mtshams kyi char/ /bdag nyid cha byad sbyor bas so/ /rta yi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje sgo lcags lde kyog ma/ /sgo ma dang ni gos 'dzin ma/ /de bzhin mtshams su spyan la sogs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de rnams kun/ /rkang pa g.yon pa brkyangs pas gnas/ /snying khar g.yon bcangs sdigs mdzub ste/ /kha dog sna tshogs cher 'bar ba'o/ /shin tu zhe sdang zhe sdang che/ /gau rī la sogs rab tu grags/ /shin tu gti mug rmongs chen las/ /skam pa ma sogs ches bzung ngo / /shin tu gzi brjid cher gsal ba/ /nyi ma la sogs rab tu grags/ /shin tu 'dod chags chags chen las/ /pad sogs chos kyi dkyil 'khor du'o/ /phrag dog chen po'i sgrib chen las/ /sgo lcags ma sogs myur 'gro bdag /shin tu zhe sdang chags chen las/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ /rgyal ba mgon po phan pa ni/ /gti mug thams cad zad par byed/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'phrog /rta mgrin 'dod pa chen po ni/ /'dod chags can gyi byang chub ster/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro phrag dog che/ /theg pa gzhan ni rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /mi bskyod ye shes 'byung pa'i gnas/ /skye med mi bzad mgron gnyer phyir/ /sgrib pa lnga ni 'joms pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par dag par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang /

/'dod chags ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ /bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /shin tu gdug pa drag po la/ /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can chen ni/ /rang gis kyai rdo rjer gyur/ /shin tu stong par zhen rnams kyi/ /yod min brtul zhugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas gti mug spyod don du/ /rdo rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyur/ /shin tu nga rgyal gdug rnams kyi/ /skye 'gro'i nga rgyal zad par mdzad/ /rdo rje nyi ma bdag nyid rgyal/ /nga rgyal chen po'i mun pa 'joms/ /byang chub chags bral las skyes spangs/ /sems can gang zhig bde byed pa/ /chags pas byang chub rab grub phyir/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gnas shing / /gang zhig lam gzhan nas 'gro ba/ /de rnams byang chub rab sbyin phyir/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro rang gtso bo/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam nyid/ /de dang de yi ngo bor 'gro/ /mchog tu phan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /gang dang gang gi dngos po yis/ /skyes pa rnams kyi yid sbyor ba/ /des na de yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs nor ji bzhin no/ /gang dang gang gis 'dul ba yis/ /sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de dang de yi rnam pa yis/ /chos kyi bshad pa bya ba 'o/ /sems kyi rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /sems can sna tshogs rang bzhin can/ /sems ni bdag gi rnam rtog gis/ /skye bo dri mas nag por byas/ /de bas kun tu rab 'bad pas/ /sems kyi rdo rje rnam par sbyang / /sems dag pa ni bde ba yin/ /nyon mongs dug ni thams cad 'phrog /gal te stong pa thabs yin na/ /de tshe sangs rgyas nyid mi 'gyur/ /'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min phyir/ /thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin/ /lta ba rnams las log rnams dang / /bdag tu lta ba 'tshol rnams kyis/ /bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir/

/stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du myur bar 'gyur/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad bcur ldan/ /de phyir thabs kyi bsgrub bya dang / /de ni thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /thams cad kyi rnam pa mchog tu zhi ba'i sems can 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje khams gsum thob/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/ /dam tshig mchod pa yid 'ong ba/ /'khor la rab tu bka' stsal pa/ /glu ni rdo rje can la 'bul/ /gar ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /hi ra mchog la de bzhin dri/ /'jig rten rje la bza' dang btung / /gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la/ /'di rnams dam tshig dam pa ste/ /rdo rje mchod pa byas pa yis/ /rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed/ /a ka ru nag kyai rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan dan dkar/ /dmar po 'jig rten rje la 'bul/ /kha che rdo rje snang ba la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i thams cad de/ /hūm̐ rdo rje las byung pa'i dri/ /'di rnams dri yi rab sbyor bas/ /dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'thob bo/ /kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer dbul/ /mngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tsha 'jig rten rjer/ /rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam/ /ska ba rab tu brtag par bya/ /kyai rdo rje rdor can gyi/ /me tog mdog gnag rkang thung 'byung / /ma lī ka dang ma la ti/ /kun da rtag tu sangs rgyas dbul/ /shing gi dbang mchog dri med mdog /snang byed la ni sbyar bar bya/ /dbang mchog dmar po chu skyes dang / /ban dha dmar po bha ṭa laṃ/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang la dbul/ /rta mchog rdo rje can la kun/ /rdo rje can gyi khru gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor khru bzhi pa/ /snang byed la ni khru lnga nyid/ /pad ma gar dbang drug pa ste/

/lcags kyi rgyal po de bzhin bdun/ /bza' las rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /lam du lcags kyi mchog gi dang / /gnyid las sangs rgyas mgon po yi/ /shin tu bde la gar dbang gi /glu gar de bzhin rol mo'i sgra/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus su ni/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su gzhag nas ni/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor rab tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje'i dbang po sngon po ste/ /zla ba chu shel thub chen gyi/ /mkhar phyin skyes pa'i me tog dmar/ /pad ma dmar po spyan ras gzigs/ /rta yi yang mar ga ta ste/ /rin chen lnga yi rdul tshon mchog /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i gur 'byung po 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /dam tshig yang dag rab phye ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i sa bon bdag /dbang po sngon po lta bu'i 'od/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /mdzes pa'i khro bo yi ni lus/ /dbang ldan 'byung po mnan pa ste/ /g.yas par rigs kyi bdag po 'dzin/ /lag pa g.yon pa skyi lpags nyid/ /gnyis po dag gis phyag rgyar sbyor/ /zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas yang dag gnas/ /cung zad mche bas 'jigs par byed/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba rgyan mchog ste/ /mgo 'dzings byed du bcing bar ni/ /ri yi rtse mor bsgom par bya/ /'byung po 'dul ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin du ma 'byung po dang / /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang / /mi mo lha yi mdzes ma ni/ /bsgrub pa po yis nges par 'grub/ /sngags ni oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma rā/ bhu da ā dhi pa ti a sho bh+yo ki ri ti na sarba bhu ta pre ta pi sā tsa na/ sa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas rdo rje chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur stobs po che'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /char chen rab tu dbab bya ste/ /pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ /der ni klu brgyad dgod par bya/ /stobs po cher ni rab sbyar bas/ /de rnams snga ma yang dag mnan/

/char med stobs po che las ni/ /chu yi tshogs ni dbab par bya/ /kha dog gnag cing cher gsal ba/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /mkha' lding rdo rjes mnan mdzad pa/ /phyag rnams kyis ni klu bdag bsnams/ /phuḥzhes pa yi sngags zlos shing / /hūm̐ dag nang du chud byas te/ /phaṭ ni mtha' ru sbyar bar bya/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /gnyis pa zla 'od bzang po nyid/ /gsum pa ser po'i mdog lta bu/ /bzhi pa dmar po nyid du brjod/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis yan lag brgyad/ /rdo rje sems dpas rnam par brgyan/ /klu rnams kyis ni char dbab phyir/ /stobs po che ni rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'dzin pa rdo rje'i gur smra ba pos sangs rgyas kyi de kho na dbye bar bya'o// ༈ //rdo rje pad ma 'o byas dang / /ri dwags brgyan pa zos pa dang / /rdo rje chu 'thungs nor ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas de nyid 'di rig dang / /dag pa'i gnas ni gnas chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab gang pa/ /rdo rje rin chen kun khyab par/ /gang 'gyur nga yis bshad par bya/ /phan pa'i grong khyer yid 'ong bar/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /zhen pa chen pos sangs rgyas kun/ /lcags sgrog rdo rjes bcing par bya/ /dga' ldan du ni ldeg par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'dod pa 'thob/ /rgyal ba mgon po byams pa ni/ /ye shes spyan gyis rnam par gzigs/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pas/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams bcing par bya/ /gang zhig dngos grub mi ster na/ /sgrog gis bcings nas dgug par bya/ /rdo rje kyo ba dkar mo che/ /rdo rje zhags pa chom rkun ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ro langs ma/ /rdo rje dril bu ghasma ri/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dbang du byed/ /bzlas dang bsgom la mngon dga' ba'i/ /dngos grub gal te mi ster na/

/de tshe mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni drag shul bsgrub/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur gyis rgyud kyi nang du 'bum phrag lnga bris pa yang dag par bshad par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni dkyil 'khor 'bum/ /rdo rje can gyi de bzhin 'bum/ /'bum gyis rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /'bum gyis rdo rje chos kyi 'o/ /'bum phrag phyed kyis rdo rje rta/ /'byung po 'dul ba stong phrag lngas/ /lnga yis las ni rab rgyas pa/ /lnga yis sangs rgyas gar mkhan nyid/ /stong phrag sum cu dag gis ni/ /ku ru ku la brtag pa 'o/ /lhag ma stong phrag lnga yis ni/ /cho ga'i rim pa rgyud kun gyi'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro kyai rdo rje/ /'bum phrag lnga ni bris pa 'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa blo dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar gyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /gar dang glu la rab zhen pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rdo rje yis/ /'dod chags can gyis byang chub bsgrub/ /de nas rdo rje can byung ste/ /me tog snyim par rab sbyor bas/ /sems can kun la phan ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig der ni bshad par bya/ /sems can ji snyed pa rnams ni/ /sems can du bsdu bas bsdus pa/ /sgong nga las skyes pa'am/ mnga' las skyes pa'am/ drod bsher las skyes pa'am/ rdzus te skyes pa'am/ gzugs can rnams sam/ gzugs med pa can rnams sam/ 'du shes can rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa can nyid rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa pa rnams sam/ sems can de dag thams cad bdag gis phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya'o/ /dam tshig che bshad de nas ni/ /zur mig mi g.yo mgon phyung ste/ /mi bskyod ye shes brnyes ldan pa'i/ /ston pa la ni rnam par smod/ /ci khyod dam tshig hūm̐ zhes bya/ /thub pa chen po gzhu can yin/ /nga min snying rje'i stobs dpal ldan/

/bdag stobs bcom pa min nam ci/ /ci khyod dam tshig oṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni tshangs pa thub pa rnams/ /nga min rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /khyod ni me bcom 'dod pa bral/ /ci khyod dam tshig a zhes bya/ /mnga' bdag mkha' lding mkhyen nam ci/ /nga min pad ma gar dbang dpal/ /khyod ni gar mkhan nyer bzhad mkhan/ /ci khyod dam tshig traṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni gdugs te tsha ba 'phrog /nga min rdo rje nyi ma dpal/ /gdugs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam khyod ci ltar min/ /ci khyod dam tshig khaṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni mkha' stong rang bzhin no/ /nga min rdo rje mgyogs 'gro yin/ /khyod ni rta ste pha rol 'gro/ /ci khyod dam tshig snying rje chang / /e ma chang 'tshong mdzes ma 'o/ /mi g.yo bdag min mā ma ki /zhang po'i grong khyer 'dzin nam ci/ /ci khyod dam tshig zhi ba nyid/ /bud med g.yo rgyu 'dzin nam ci/ /bdag ni ma yin lha mo spyan/ /spyan yin na ni g.yo dang bcas/ /ci khyod dam tshig 'dod chags che/ /smad 'tshong ma la ci smrar yod/ /bdag min lha mo gos dkar mo/ /ci ltar dri ma dkar ba yin/ /ci khyod dam tshig dbang byed che/ /btsun mo'i pho nya yin nam ci/ /bdag min zur mig sgrol ma 'o/ /sgrol ma mig ni bcom pa yin/ /mig yon bdag ni nor dpal ldan/ /de ltar ngo tsha med pas legs/ /ngo tsha med pas sangs rgyas min/ /mthong dang mi mthun nyung du smros/ /de nas rdo rje mig yon po smod pa pos gsungs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang che/ /thub pa rnam par snang mdzad rmongs/ /'dod la zhen pa 'jig rten bdag /ser sna rdo rje snang byed de/ /skyon ni don yod thams cad byed/ /'dren pa lnga ni skyon ldan no/ /sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa 'am/ /drod gsher skyes dang mtha' 'khob bzhin/ /gzugs can rnams dang gzugs med dam/ /rdzus nas skyes pa nyid dang ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bya 'o zhes/ /khyod kyis dang por gsungs pa ni/

/khyod nyid sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /de rnams ji ltar rgyal ma mdzad/ /de nyid phyir na brdzun gsungs pa/ /mnga' bdag ji ltar 'di ma gsungs/ /sems can bslus nas khyod kyis gang / /sangs rgyas nyid de ngo mtshar rmad/ /'chi ba'i tshe 'am mu ge 'am/ /phas kyi 'khor lo'i gnod pa 'am/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /char pa med dang zhi ba la/ /sngags dang bsgom par ldan par ni/ /gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol ba/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste/ /der ni brdzun du mi 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon lnga dang lha mo bzhi/ /mi g.yo'i bdag nyid smod pa po/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol par mdzad/ /khams 'dul de bzhin rtsa ba 'am/ /ma dag pa yi rgyan rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar mkhan gar/ /bde ba dga' bar byed dang bcas/ /chos 'byung grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje dam tshig glu yis dang / /rdo rje rkang pa'i goms pa'i gar/ /mthar ni rdza rnga la s+yā+e sogs/ /phyag rgya chen po rab ster ba'i/ /de nyid 'di ni ches gsang ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' ji bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /glu sna tshogs dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / gar dang 'dul bar 'jug pa dang / char dbab pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur rdo rje gur gyi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ 'byung po chen po'i gtor ma gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /pad ma 'dab brgyad bsgom par bya/ /dbang po shar gyi 'dab mar bsam/ /mthar byed lhor ni dgod par bya/ /chu bdag nub kyi pad ma la/ /byang du gnod sbyin dgod par bya/ /mer ni byin za chen po nyid/ /bden bral mtshams skyong de bzhin no/ /rlung du gnas med bsam par bya/ /dbang ldan du ni 'byung po gtso/ /nyi zla tshangs pa la sogs dang /

/tshangs pa'i rigs ni dam pa dang / /tshangs pa 'dun na 'don nyid dang / /dga' ldan 'thab bral gnas pa dang / /rgyal po chen por gyur pa dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang bsgyur nyid dang ni/ /gang zhig 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang / /gtsang ma'i gnas su gang gnas dang / /bde ba can na 'dug pa dang / /'og min du ni gnas pa dang / /'od zer can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa dang / /de kun steng du gnas par bya/ /chos 'byung nang du son pa ni/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan nyid/ /pad chen pad ma bzang po can/ /lha min sems can dmyal ba rnams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'og tu 'o/ /oṃ las tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /hūm̐ las ma chags pa la sogs/ /a las stobs kyi rgyu la sogs/ /lag gnyis gdong gcig ldan rnams te/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po che/ /dbang po la sogs nag po mtshungs/ /rang mtshungs rig mas lus spras nas/ /rdo rje dril bus lag pa brel/ /g.yas brkyangs pas ni stan la gnas/ /tshangs sogs rtag pas phyag rgyas gdab/ /mchod sbyin brgya sogs rdo rje yis/ /stobs kyi rgyu sogs gar dbang gis/ /thams cad rigs gsum las skyes pa'o/ /dkar mos dgug par byas nas ni/ /chom rkun mas ni zhags 'ching bas/ /ro langs mas ni sgrog bcing bas/ /ghasma ri ni dril bus dbang / /de nas mchod yon zhabs bsil dbul/ /sngags 'di yis ni bsang gtor bya/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyis ni 'thor 'thung dbul bar bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra swa twa sa ma yā/ ma nu pa la ya/ dri ḍhā+o me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sā swa to me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ hri da ya m+me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba kā r+ye ṣu tsa m+me tsi ta pre ya ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta ma mā+e muñtsa badz+ri bha ba sa ma ya swa twa āḥ

muḥ/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur rdo rje ming gi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ rdo rje'i ming phye ba'o/ /ming gi dbang gi dus su ni/ /slob ma bdag nyid dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur ba/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / mdzes pa'i rdo rje dang / rol pa'i rdo rje dang / shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / shin tu dga' ba myu gu'i rdo rje dang / pad ma rdo rje dang / pad ma myu gu rdo rje dang / a la la rdo rje dang / pad ma lcags kyu rdo rje dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rdo rje dang / yan lag med pa'i rdo rje dang / shes rab myu gu'i rdo rje dang / snying rje'i myu gu'i rdo rje dang / dam par dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / shin tu bde bar dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo rje dang / 'jug pa'i rdo rje dang / nam mkha' rdo rje dang / shes rab rdo rje dang / pha rol phyin pa'i rdo rje dang / 'dod chags rdo rje ni dag pa'i gnas su phyag rgya chen po grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i ming ni 'di rnams so/ /bud med rnams kyi 'byung ste/ rdo rje snyems ma dang / rdo rje mtshon cha ma dang / rdo rje e ma'o bde ma dang / rdo rje bdag med ma dang / rdo rje spyan ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / rdo rje dkar mo dang / rdo rje sgyu ma dang / rdo rje 'bar ma dang / rdo rje 'khri shing ma dang / rdo rje mgyogs ma dang / rdo rje ro langs ma dang / rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje a ba li dang / rdo rje 'phreng ma dang / rdo rje la s+yā+e ma dang / rdo rje bzhad ma dang / rdo rje 'khyud ma dang / rdo rje phye ma dang / rdo rje pad ma dang / rdo rje 'byung ma dang / rdo rje chen mo dang / rdo rje 'dod chags ma dang / rdo rje sgrol ma dang /

rdo rje do shal ma dang / rdo rje sgeg mo dang / rdo rje blo gros ma dang / rdo rje kong ka na dang / rdo rje lā lā ma dang / rdo rje dbugs dbyung ma dang / rdo rje rnam pa ma ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan du gyur pa/ kyai rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rnam snang chen po dang ni rang 'byung dang / /rdo rje ra li skem pa'i khro bo dang / /de bzhin du yang rdo rje khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang / /he ru ka dang snying rje'i stobs nyid do/ /rtag pa dang ni gti mug rdo rje dang / /rnam par snang mdzad dang ni thams cad skyob/ /sgyu 'phrul dang ni de nas oṃ mdzad dang / /sku yi rdo rje rab tu grags pa dang / /sa snying dang ni gti mug chen po dang / /gshin rje gshed dang tho ba'i dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gshegs dang shākya thub pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhes byar rab tu grags pa 'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma de nas rin chen bdag /de bzhin du yang rin chen rgyal po nyid/ /rdo rje gzi brjid dang ni rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bdud zil non dang ni snang byed do/ /rta mgrin dang ni 'jig rten bdag po dang / /rdo rje chos dang spyan ras gzigs dang ni/ /pad ma gar dbang dang ni 'dod chags dang / /'jig rten mgon por rab tu grags pa 'o/ /dam pa'i rta dang rta yi rgyal po dang / /bdun gyi rgyal po de nas lcags rgyal dang / /dam tshig rdo rje dang ni rta mchog dang / /de bzhin du yang las kyi rdo rje nyid/ /don yod dang ni don yod grub pa dang / /rdo rje mgyogs 'gror rab tu grags pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de nas rdo rje can/ /rnam par rgyal ba phyag na rdo rje dang / /dpe med ro mnyam shin tu dga' ba dang / /dam pa dang po bde ba chen po 'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /dam tshig sems dpa' nor bu ni/ /'di rnams rigs ni drug tu brjod/

/'dod pa'i thar pa bsgrub pa 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni gsum pa 'o/ /bzhi pa sna tshogs brtag pa zhes/ /rdo rje'i brtag pa lnga pa 'o/ /brtag pa drug pa stobs po che/ /brtag pa bdun pa mi g.yo mgon/ /brgyad pa gzungs kyi brtag pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu/ /bcu pa 'dul ba'i brtag pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcu gcig pa/ /dngos grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ /sgrol ma'i brtag pa bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje phag mo bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa ni gzi brjid che/ /bdag med brtag pa bcu drug pa/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bcu bdun pa/ /hūm̐ mdzad la ni bco brgyad pa/ /dbyangs can gyi ni bcu dgu pa/ /sbyin sreg brtag pa nyi shu pa/ /rab gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i brtag pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis su ni brjod/ /gtor ma'i brtag pa nyi shu gsum/ /nyi shu bzhi pa sta gon gnas/ /mngon par rtogs pa nyi shu lnga/ /de bzhin phyag rgya nyi shu drug /byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /glu ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cur gcig med sum cu pa/ /brtag pa sum cu par ni bshad/ /stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyis ni/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /kyai rdo rje rdor 'chang gi /rgyud ni e ma rgyas bstan pa/ /'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje'i/ /dag pa'i snying pos yongs bzung pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa 'o/ /kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang por rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med gzung phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na spros pa las bsdus pa lags/

bskal pa bzang po la byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang so so'i skye bo rnams tshe thung bar 'gyur na/ ji ltar na de rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams thos par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams sems par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa tshe thung bar 'gyur ba lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig gang dag slob dpon rnams su 'gyur ba de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba dang / gang dag spyod pa po de rnams ni mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag so so'i skye bo de dag srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag ma mo'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dod pa la zhen par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir na rgyud thams cad kyi bstan pa rgyas pa ma yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje'i gsung thos nas/ mnyes par gyur cing dgyes pa rnyed nas tshig 'di gsungs pa/ snying rje chen po rdo rje che/ /nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /bsnyen bskur can la dngos grub ster/ /mtsho skyes rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong / /sku gdung zab mo'i mchod rten dang / /rkang 'thung rlon pa'i 'og tu ni/ /nga ni sangs rgyas dngos grub ster/ /tshong dus grong brdal nyid dang ni/ /yang thog rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma brtan pa dang / /bsnyen bskur can la dngos grub ster/ /glu gar rab tu 'ching ba dang / /chang 'tshong ma yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad ma gar mkhan nga / /bsnyen bskur can la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mgyogs 'gro zhon 'gyur dang / /res 'ga' lam du 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod brtan pa nga / /dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur phyag rgya rnam par rgyal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/

phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan yang dag par bshad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi brtag pa las/ /phyag rgya rnam gsum shes par bya/ /sku la lag pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /sngags bzlas pa las ngag phyag rgya/ /sems la mtshan ma'i phyag rgya yin/ /de nyid bsam gtan dkyil 'khor lo/ /lag pa g.yas pa skam pa ste/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro skam pa ma 'jigs ma/ /gdug pa rnams kyi 'khur ba 'don/ /g.yas pa'i lag na zhags pa ste/ /gdug pa rnams bcings rnam par dgug /de 'di zhags pa ma zhes bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /g.yas na nya rgya zlum po ste/ /gdug pa rnams ni bkri bar 'dod/ /'di ni rtag tu dol zlum bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /lag pa g.yas par lcags kyu ste/ /gdug pa rnams ni dgug par 'dod/ /'di de rdo rje kyo mar bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug la sdigs mdzub ma/ /lag pa g.yas par nyi ma ste/ /gti mug mun pa rnam par 'dral/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mar ni bshad/ /'di ni rdo rje nyi mar 'dod/ /lag g.yas mar me'i sdong snod de/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs mdzub bo/ /'di de rdo rje mar mer bshad/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib brjod/ /lag pa g.yas na rin po che/ /sems can rnams la sbyin pa ster/ /g.yon par sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rin chen sgron mar 'di rab brjod/ /glog ni lag pa g.yas par te/ /rnam par rtog pa'i chu sbyin 'joms/ /de 'di glog lag mar shes bya/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs mdzub ma/ /lag pa g.yas par pad ma ste/ /pad ma'i 'dod chags brjod par bya/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub ma nyid de/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro pad mar bshad/ /g.yas par ba ga'i pad ma ste/ /bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni chos 'byung mar ni brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag na lcags sgrog ste/ /byang chub zhen pas kun 'ching ba/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/

/'di ni rdo rje sgrog mar brjod/ /sangs rgyas rjes chags 'ching ba yis/ /bdag nyid 'khyud mar 'dod pa ste/ /byang chub chags pas rab bsgrub ma/ /'di ni rdo rje 'khyud par bshad/ /g.yas pa'i lag na sgo lcags te/ /ye shes kun gyi bsrung ba mo/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje sgo lcags brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag tu lde kyog ste/ /ye shes blangs nas gcod pa mo/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje lde kyog brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag pas sgo ma ni/ /ye shes skyes pa ma spangs pa 'o/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di ni rdo rje sgo mar brjod/ /lag pa g.yas par yol ba ni/ /rang mtshungs btsun mo bsrung ba nyid/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje yol ba mor ni brjod/ /de 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i gsung thob nas ngo mtshar skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya 'phrog pa 'di ni ci nyi tshe ba'i dam tshig phyag rgya 'phrog pa lags sam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i lung bstan pa yod de 'di ni de'i yin te/ ḍai bā+ai hā ya sa ga ma ne'i skad kyi dbyings 'dis rnam par brtags pa ste/ thams cad kun tu nam mkhar spyod par grub pas/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro mar rab tu grags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad tshig 'di thos nas dga' ba mgu ba nye bar thob par gyur nas/ tshig 'di dag gsol pa/ /e ma mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ /rgyud kun las ni phyi ma dang /

/rtogs sla rtogs par dka' ba dang / /rig dang mi rig pa nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskul ba'i phyir 'di skad gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di la rdo rje'i gur rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'dir ji ltar rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bsdu ba yin/ byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol pa/ sgo nga las skye ba la sogs pa mtha' yas pa ngas srid pa las bsgral bar bya'o zhes smon lam sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub gong du rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs na/ ci'i phyir srog chags rnams gsad pa dang / gcig tu 'dod pa'i btsun mo rnams spangs lags/ lta ba las ni log rnams dang / /btsun mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /bde ba'i thabs ni mdor bsdus pa/ /gzhung nyung don ni rgyas pa ste/ /blo dman rab tu sad byed pa/ /rgyud kun gyi ni snying por nges/ /sngags rnams kyi ni khyad par du'o/ /rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'di ni bshad pa tsam gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis/ /sngon du gar gyis mchod byas te/ /rang gi 'khor la 'di gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /gal te rdo rje chos dang ni/ /rta mchog rdo rje nyi ma yang / /bdag gis spangs na mi 'grub ste/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yum gyi gzugs kyis skyed par byed/ /de rnams kyi ni mdzes ma nga / /de la nga ni dngos grub ster/ /mig sman dang ni rkang byug dang / /ral gri sa 'og sgrub pa dang / /ri lu mkha' la spyod pa dang / /mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur ba nyid/ /bu mo dam pa 'gugs pa ni/ /bdag mnyes pas ni sgrub pa pos/

/dngos grub rdo rje rnams 'thob bo/ /spros pa rnam pa mang por ni/ /smras pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya/ /bdag spangs nges par mi 'grub cing / /byang chub med cing bsgom pa med/ /gang zhig rtag tu bdag dran zhing / /rtag tu klog cing sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang / /nga yi sku ni bsgom byed pa/ /gal te sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /shin tu bsgom pa'i rim pa las/ /mngon sum du ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu sbyor ba las/ /de yi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje pad ma rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu bde chen sbyor ba las/ /gang zhig bdag la 'dod ster ba/ /lus can de lta smos ci dgos/ /gang zhig nyi ma gcig bsgom pa/ /rdo rje mchod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dngos grub/ /ster te 'di la the tshom med/ /bdag nyid he ru kar byas shing / /rang gi btsun mo ngar bsgoms nas/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor ches 'dod pa/ /de rnams la ni nga mnyes 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan zhing / /spro ba dga' bar ldan pa dang / /glu dang rol sgra'i rnam pa dang / /'dod kun bde ba spro ba dang / /sna tshogs sgeg par ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs ro yi btung ba dang / /sna tshogs gos kyi ri mo can/ /sna tshogs dri yi byug pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag dang rtag nyal ba/ /de yi dngos grub ster ba nga / /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'dug pa/ /de yi 'dod pa mar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a ā i ī u ū ri rī li lī e ai o au aṃ a swāhā/ gang zhig 'dis nga skul bar byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de rnams kyi yan lag tu bud med kyi sgyu ma'i bde ba yang dag pa'i gnas kyis 'dug go /rdo rje ma ni shar du sbyin par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni dkar mo'i gzugs can ma'o/ /nub phyogs su ni chu'i mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o/

/nga dbus su gzhag ste/ snying po dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gang zhig bsam par byed pa de'i bdag mdzes ma ste/ phyag gnyis zhal gcig ma'o/ /gri gug dang skyes pa'i thod pas brel ba/ stag gi pags pa bgos pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ shar gyi sgor ni dkar mo chen mo'o/ /lhor ni chom rkun ma'o/ /nub kyi sgor ni chu ma'o/ /de bzhin du byang du ni ghasma ri'o/ /dbang ldan du ni pu k+ka si'o/ /'tshed pa'i mtshams su ri khrod ma'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su gdol pa mo'o/ /rtag tu 'gro bar ni g.yung mo'o/ /'di sogs rnams ni mtshams dang mtshams bral du sbyin no/ /gang zhig bdag rab tu sgom par byed pa de'i yan lag mthil du phyin pa'i dpal sus kyang dbrog par mi nus so/ /thams cad kyang kha dog nag por mtshungs pa/ rab tu son pa'i steng du/ gar dang bcas pa/ khro mo chen mo/ dpa' mo/ g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa mo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur mchog tu dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ rig ma'i dbang yang dag par bshad pa/ rang gi rig ma skyes bu'i chus/ /bum pa brgyad po thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje thugs ni rab bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje can rnams dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab bsgoms la/ /der ni dbu rgyan sbyin par bya/ /thams cad sngon bzhin nges bsams nas/ /rdo rje tshigs bcad sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /snying kar rang gi lag pa bya/ /slob ma 'jig rten dbang phyug byas/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur byas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang 'dis ni/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /bzang grub phyir ni rdo rje zungs/ /slob ma lcags mchog lha mo ni/ /sgrol mas 'khyud pa bsam par bya/ /lag pas rdo rje dril 'khrol zhing /

/rdo rje bdag pos dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ā dhī pa ti twaṃ abhī ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ slob ma rnam snang byas nas ni/ /ming gis kyang ni dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhī ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye che ge mo rdo rje/ gang gang kun gyi rang gtsor 'gyur/ /de de bdag nyid he ru ka/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi rang bzhin dag pa 'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rdo rje snying po'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dha ra ya mi hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ kun kyang cho ga gcig pa yis/ /rtag tu bla med chos nas ni/ /slob ma rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ /phyis ni rdo rje lag nas lag /sems dpa' thog ma mtha' med pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' chen po/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /yang ni der ni dril bu sbyin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /rgyal bas byang chub mchog brjod pa/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /dbugs 'byin thams cad byin nas ni/ /shākya thub par rang gyur nas/ /slob ma chen po lung bstan te/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tsom med/ /khyod kyi 'chi 'jigs mya ngan med/ /de bzhin nad dang tsha ba med/ /bde chen theg pa chen po ni/ /'di las nga yis lung bstan bu/ /oṃ e sho haṃ bh+ya ka ro mi twāṃ badz+ra sa twa ta thā ga ta/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bsgral te/ /shin tu srid pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /kye grub 'gyur de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /ming ni rdo rje zhes byar 'gyur/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis rig ma chen mo'i dbang gi dam tshig bka' stsal to/

/de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje ston pa pos dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ bla ma rdo rje rnams mchod cing / /bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas su/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgom/ /de la sangs rgyas gnas bsams nas/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /dang po'i skyes bu bsams de nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo spro/ /dri za mnyam par zhugs nas ni/ /khu bar rjes su dran par bya/ /mtshams kyi lha mos bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa 'dren pa bskul nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa'i gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /phyi nas rjes chags rdo rje ste/ /ye shes rnam par zhugs pa yang / /dbang ni rig ma brgyad rnams kyi/ /yang ni bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa nyid/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa bstod pa 'o/ /rang byin brlab pas byin brlabs te/ /de la yan lag drug bsgom bya/ /phyi nas yang ni dam tshig go /cho ga'i go rim rim pa yis/ /mtshan ma yang dag mtshon par bya/ /dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba nyid/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub nye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rjes nas sgyu ma'i rnam pa bltar/ /rmi lam rnam pa skad cig 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji srid rdo rje lus can rnams/ /ye shes phung po'i blo ldan pa/ /de yi rjes su thams cad 'brang / /ji srid skye gnas las byung pa/ /khams gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /phyag rgya chen po rab sbyor ba/ /de rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/

/tshig gi rdo rje rnams thos nas/ /dga' zhing drangs par gyur nas ni/ /smra ba'i rdo rje'i mdzad par ldan/ /rig ma chen mo bdag med dang / /rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen dang / /rta mchog thub pa chen po dang / /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid che/ /rta mgrin mnga' bdag chen po ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni nyid dang yang / /lus kyi gong bu 'gul bar 'gyur/ /lan cig rgyal po bton pa yis/ /'phral du mngon sum byed pa po/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin pa po mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te tshig 'di gsungs so/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ /zhal brgyad pa la stobs po che/ /phyag ni bcu drug rnams dang ldan/ /dbang po'i sngon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gzi brjid chen po zhabs bzhi pa/ /sgeg cing khro bo'i gzugs can te/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /dkar po dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa ste/ /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /der ni rdo rje mdog nag po/ /'od zer chen po bsgom par bya/ /dbang bskur ba yi gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang shā ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad du ni/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /drod dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /skyes bu chen po bzhengs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gti mug rdo rje mig la 'god/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rna ba la/ /ser sna 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /reg dang bdag med bsgom par bya/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa yin/ /sna tshogs gzugs ma btsun mo nyid/

/lag pa gri gug thod pas brel/ /srog son steng du yang dag gnas/ /sa spyod mkha' spyod ma nyid dang / /de bzhin rkang 'og gnas pa mo/ /'di nyid kyi ni cho ga yis/ /gnas gsum du ni gnas par bsgom/ /oṃ mdzad rgyal po chen po ni/ /sku yi rdo rjes rnam par brgyan/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /a ni mchog gi de nyid de/ /ngag gi lam ni gsal byed brjod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /chos can la ni rigs gsum 'byung / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dkar mo'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /kha dog dkar mo 'od chen mo/ /dkar mo rdo rje can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dmar mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /chom rkun ma yi gzugs can bsgom/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /rdo rje zhags pa mtshon chen mo/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ro langs ma ni khrag dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog nga rgyal byed/ /byang chub 'ching par mdzad pa mo/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /de nas ghas sma ri bsgom bya/ /rdo rje dril bus lag pa brel/ /mar gad ut+pal 'dra ba 'o/ /rdo rje sgo skyong ma rdo rje brtson ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mtshams su lha mo bzhi rnams ni/ /cho ga'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /byang sems bum pa ri rab dang / /me yi thab khung rgyal mtshan rtse/ /gnyis bcas gnyis med rnal 'byor las/ /mgon po de ltar bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /rba rlabs med pa'i bde ba 'thob/ /'byung pa bzhi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po theg pa gsum gyi dam pa ston pa po thams cad kyi rnam pa ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ hūm̐ las byung pa'i khro bo ni/

/rtag tu zhe sdang ldan pa 'o/ /nang du ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ na maḥ sa man+ta bud dhe bh+yo na moḥ badz+ra mud ka ra hasta ya tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la a k+ṣe pa ka ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas 'dir khro bo chen po bshad pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs shing 'dar bar gyur nas/ mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa dran par byed do/ /skyes pa'i pad ma chag gas med/ /srub gcig pa dang srub gnyis pa/ /rig ma bzhi ni rab sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu dgang / /rkang rjes rdul gyi cho ga yis/ /rkang pas mnan cing bsdig par bya/ /sku gsum bskyed pa'i bsgom pa yis/ /bu mo chen mo dgug par bya/ /gshin rje gshed rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud dhe bh+yo mahā ḍaṇ+ḍa dha ra bi bi dha ra su rā a su rā mar+ha na bhu tā n+nīr+m+ma tha hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa stobs po che bshad pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang 'dar bar gyur cing de dran par byed do/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za nyid/ /mkha' 'gro grul bum zin pa la/ /hūm̐ gis dregs byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje btsir bas bde ba nyid/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo hu lu hu lu/ mahā pad+ma ma a mri te ku ru mahā bi ṣa na aḥ btsan dug chen po dgug par bya/ /brgyal ba bslang pa de bzhin no/ /pad ma'i dregs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo badz+ra kro dha ya mahā daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ro t+ka ṭa bhā+ai ra wa ya badz+ra san+do ha dar+pa pā ya a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po bgegs 'joms rdo rje can bshad pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams yid mi dga' bar gyur to/

/rlung gis bteg pa po dang / rkang rjes kyi rdul blangs nas/ bsgrub bya de'i ming yang bzung ste/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i rkang pa'i 'og tu dgod cing hūm̐ phaṭ ces bya ste/ hūm̐ gi nga rgyal byas nas rdo rje bdud rtsi ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i khro bo'i sngags kyi sbyor bas sangs rgyas rnams kyang skrod par byed do/ /bdud rtsi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //shin tu legs par gsang ba ni/ /bya ba 'di ni rab bskul ba/ /ye shes rdo rjes bya bas te/ /nyi ma bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo oṃ ya ma daṇ+ḍā ya nī lā ya ṇi la daṇ+ḍā ya tu ru tu ru mu ru mu ru sarba duṣ+ṭan ma rā yā ma rā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po skyes bu chen po bshad pas/ sems can thams cad dang sangs rgyas rnams srog la the tshom du gyur to/ /brgya phrag brgyad bzlas pa tsam gyis dang shin tu skom bas sbyor ba'i cho gas bskul ba las/ gdug pa thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyug pas mnan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo mahā ba la ya u ts+tshu ṣ+ma kro dha rā dzā ya sarba nā gā nāṃ hri da yaṃ tā ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas gtum po chen po bshad pas dug gi gdong 'jigs shing stobs dang bral ba dang / skrag cing 'dar bar gyur te/ stobs po che dran par byed do/ /rdo rje stobs kyi spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo a tsa la kā nā tse ṭ+ṭa tse ṭ+ṭa mo ṭ+ṭa mo ṭ+ṭa tu ṭ+ṭa tu ṭ+ṭa gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba skyes bu chen po bshad pas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin chen po brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /'dis ni khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ /seng ge zhon pa'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor las/

/skyes pa dang ni lha rnams zhugs/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum bha hūm̐ gh+rih+ṇa gh+rih+ṇa hūm̐ gh+rih+na pa ya gh+rih+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho bha ga wan bid+ya rā dzā hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa yi/ /khro bo chen po bshad pa yis/ /lha min bu mo klu mor bcas/ /nu ma 'dar zhing nar pa ma/ /rdo rje zhags pas nges bcings te/ /lcags kyu yis ni dral nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pa yis/ /bu mo thams cad dgug par bya/ /'jig rten gsum dgug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //rdo rje chos ni char sprin che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' char mchog ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma dge 'dun che/ /rta mchog tshogs ni chen po dang / /phan pa'i yang ni char sprin gyis/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i bsgom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'gugs brjod na/ /sa yi skye bo smos ci dgos/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bsams/ /sku gsung rdo rjes rnam par brgyan/ /lcags kyu la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /bu mo bkug la bza' bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chen pos dgug pa'i dam tshig bka' bstsal to/ /na maḥs man+ta bhud dhā+e bh+yo oṃ ḍaḥk+ki hūm̐ dza/ kha ti dang ni btsag la yang / /rdo rje lcags kyu'i sbyor ba las/ /zla ba nye bar chags dus su/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /ming ni bris pa tsam gyis dang / /brgya ni gsal bar bzlas pa yis/ /skra ldan gnas med dbang po drag /chung mar bcas pa dgug par bya/ /dam tshig lcags kyu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //bsam gtan sngags dang ting 'dzin gnas/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bdag /dgug pa'i gnas su gzung bar bya/ /thub pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dhārmā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa traḥ oṃ bi ma la oṃ shaṃ ka ra oṃ pra t+yad+gi ra badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra bar+t+ti sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra mu la kar+m+ma bhan+dha na tā ḍa na ki la naṃ ma ma kri te ye na kā+ai na tsi ta kri taṃ ta ta sarban+tu tshin+dha tshin+dha bhin+da bhin+da/

tsi ri tsi ri gi ri gi ri ma ra ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ bdag nyid bsrung pa'i sbyor ba las/ /sbyor ba rgyud sogs gzhig pa la/ /dpung pa rig mas 'khyud byas nas/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 'da' mi nus/ /khro bo chen po'i 'khor lo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //dben pa'am nags tshal nyid du yang / /yid gnyis thams cad rnam spangs la/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni 'di bsgrubs na/ /thub pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /khro bo chen po'i snying po'i 'khor lo'i snying po'i sngags la 'jug pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ //de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /sems can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las byung pa/ /yang dag rab tu nges par dbye/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje rnam snang dran par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rab bsgoms nas/ /'dod chags rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /sems can gzugs brnyan rnam bsgom ste/ /rta yi don yod rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan las byung pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni rtag bsgom bya/ /thams cad rnams kyi sngags 'di yis/ /snying kar ye shes gnas su dgod/ /ye shes sems dpar rab sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rang sngags yi ge rdzogs pa dang / /phyag rgya dang ni phyag mtshan brtag /spro dang bsdu ba byas pas ni/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal po ni/

/rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung po rab tu grags/ /ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid/ /rdo rje chos ni de bzhin gshegs/ /reg la rnam gsum rnam shes nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod yon 'bras bu ster ba po/ /bsrung pa'i dam tshig dbus gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /lnga lnga'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes lnga yi rnam par bsgom/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /'od zer sna tshogs kun tu khyab/ /sna tshogs las ni byed par brjod/ /thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yi/ /rdul tshon gyis kyang bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /phung po lngar ni rab tu grags/ /sangs rgyas mgon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /shar gyi char ni rab tu grags/ /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma 'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje yi/ /byang du rta yi rgyal po yi/ /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /dmar po nub kyi cha nyid du/ /brtsod ni byang du yang dag ldan/ /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo yi logs dang ya phubs su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs snang ba rnams kyis mdzes/ /sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gyur pa ni/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /snying po yongs bzung dkyil 'khor te/ /dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa 'am/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga ru/ /gang tshe dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yi/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog de bzhin rdo rje nyid/

/'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chen po'i dam tshig de skad bka' stsal to/ /dom dang bya rgod de bzhin bse/ /bsnyug glang dang ni stag nyid dang / /spre'u dang snas 'thung ba lang tshe/ /rdo rje chos kyi g.yas na 'o/ /khwa 'ug bya dkar seng ge dang / /mtshor gnas de bzhin ra dang ni/ /ri dwags phag dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yas min par ni rtag tu gnas/ /rma bya ma he chu srin dang / /nya yi rgyal po rus sbal dang / /'og gi klu dang ngang pa dang / /ri bong phan pa'i g.yas pa na/ /sbal ba thu bo sprin shugs kyi/ /kha chu mig sman mtshungs byi ba/ /g.yag dang dri ldan de bzhin bshad/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na 'o/ /ka ran ta dang 'khor lo ngag /lug dang tsa go ra dang ni/ /bye khra hor khra 'ol ba dang / /ku rar nyi ma'i g.yas na 'o/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /rigs ldan pad ma pad bzang can/ /'jog po nor rgyas mtha' yas ni/ /rin chen rgyal po'i g.yon na 'o/ /gza' lag phur bu mjug ring dang / /sgra gcan mig dmar pa ba sangs/ /spen pa khyab 'jug rta rgyal gyi/ /g.yas pa nyid du rab tu grags/ /dbang po tshangs pa de bzhin drag /'dod lha de bzhin thong pa can/ /gcer bu dang ni thag bzangs ris/ /stobs ldan zhes bya g.yon na 'o/ /glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin 'bog /khong skems mdze dang rkang shu dang / /mchin pa mcher pa'i rang bzhin yang / /glang po la sogs rab tu grags/ /lcags rtags dang ni rjed byed dang / /khrag rdo gcong nad rgyal po dang / /gzhang 'brum skran dang bkres rab dang / /mig ser dom la sogs pa 'o/ /rdzi ma byi dang so nad dang / /mkhris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung / /bad kan 'dzag dang lus gas dang / /skya rbab 'bras ni rma bya sogs/ /rkang 'bam tshil nad glig skrangs dang / /rgyu ma 'phel dang gsud pa dang / /tshad pa rims dang rab gas ni/ /ka ran sgra sogs rab tu grags/ /rlung mkhris de bzhin ma zhu ba/

/sgrib g.yogs rab rib gcing sri ba/ /gzhogs phyed na dang lkog 'bras dang / /rlung rgyas gza' lhag la sogs pa 'o/ /mi yi 'gro ba'ang dam pa ni/ /rab mchog de lta bu 'gro ba/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rab mchog ni/ /mi rnams kyi ni 'gro ba ste/ /thams cad nad kyis khyab mthong nas/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni cher grags pa/ /bdag gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /sems can rnams la gdungs ma gyur/ /nad rnams zhi phyir sangs rgyas ni/ /glang po la sogs nad 'dzin to/ /de ltar bsgoms par gyur pa la/ /nad med ru tsa tred grum med/ /'chi med nges par khong nad med/ /nga rgyal med cing gti mug med/ /bkres pa med cing skom pa med/ /sdug bsngal ngan 'gro de bzhin med/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams sam/ /gang gis kyang ni nad med min/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po lus thams cad 'dzin pa po mkha' 'gro ma'i yid 'phrog pa tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ sems kyi rjes dran dmigs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /sems kyi rin chen bsams nas ni/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /las rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'khor lo chen po rab bsgom bya/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni mchog rab ster/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgoms nas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje rnam snang bsams nas ni/ /phyag rgya bsgoms pas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /rin chen phung po rab bsgom bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rab sbyor bas/ /las kyi rdo rjes phyag rgyas gdab/ /zhe sdang rgyal po rgyal po che/ /skyon rnams thams cad zad par mdzad/ /spro zhing sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /bsdu ba yang ni yang dag bshad/ /sangs rgyas mgon po rab bsgoms nas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu khyab/

/spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgom bya/ /sems kyi rin chen rin po che/ /bdud kyi skyon rnams zad par mdzad/ /sems kyi char sprin sbyor ba yis/ /yang ni bsdu ba bstan par bya/ /chos kyi rgyal po gti mug che/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i gzugs can te/ /thun tshod bzhir ni byin gyis brlab/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems ni mgyogs 'gro ltar bsams nas/ /gzhal med 'bras bu stsol ba po/ /rta mchog char sprin chen po yis/ /bsdu ba yang ni bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis spro ba dang bsdu ba'i dam tshig chen po de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rnyog med dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sku yi yi ge rnam par bsgom/ /khrag gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyi rin chen yi ger dgod/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /gsung gi yi ge rnam par bsgom/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /don yod yi ge'i gzugs can te/ /sku gsum mi phyed bsgoms pa yis/ /ye shes rdo rjes bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mi phyed pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam snang la/ /rin chen sems kyi rin po che/ /pad ma bzang po'i pad ma dmar/ /shes rab ral gri don yod kyi/ /shes rab rnon po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam rtog ri bo bcad nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po ldan par 'gyur/ /dpag tshad bye ba rgyas par ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /phan pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang yang / /rin chen phung po 'od chen dang / /chos kyi phung po'i mgon chen dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje las/ /sna tshogs 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis gang /

/thams cad du ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /mtshams kyi lha mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab bsgrub bya/ /dam tshig 'khor lor bcug pa yi/ /ye shes rdo rje chen po 'bar/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /skad cig la ni gnyis med 'gyur/ /ru trā ra k+ṣa dung ral gri dang / /bu yi 'tsho ba pad 'bras dang / /mu tig la sogs byi ru sogs/ /bsam gtan ldan par sngags bzlas bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes chen la la zhig /skad kyi nga rgyal bos pa na/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'ong 'gyur ba/ /de ltar skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs/ /'jig rten khams ni stong phrag dang / /nam mkha'i khams kyi mkha' grong du/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bde gnas kyi/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de rnams sngags rig drung mi gshegs/ /rdo rje'i spyan gyis rnam par gzigs/ /gang gis sngags kyi rim thob pa/ /e ma de yis byang chub thob/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sngags kyi spyod pa dang por 'dzin/ /rdo rje sngags ni rab bsgoms pas/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes 'thob/ /de ltar shes pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i rim gnas pa/ /'bras bu nyid la mi gzigs te/ /de ni sangs rgyas mnyam par brjod/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal dmigs nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba/ /gang zhig bsgom pa de bas na/ /sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/ /'jig rten ji ltar sangs rgyas de/ /ji ltar chos ni rnyog pa med/ /sems can khams ni de ltar bshad/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /ngan par brtags pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /rin chen sems ni ci dran byas/ /sems dag pas ni dag par 'gyur/ /ji ltar nam mkha' mi 'jig pa/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin de bzhin sems/

/sems kyi rin chen bskul ba las/ /sems nyid bsgoms pas sangs rgyas te/ /skye bar sangs rgyas dam pa nyid/ /rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don dam/ /phyi rol gyur pa'ang cung zad med/ /yid kyis sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal po che/ /sems gcig gis ni thob par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya'i rang bzhin skyes/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mchog tu zhi/ /'di ni rin chen mchog tu brjod/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes nyid/ /'di dag thams cad sems la skye/ /thub pa 'di ni gzhan mi 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /'dod don 'bras bu rab ster ba/ /sems kyi de nyid rang bzhin dag /sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras bu ster/ /de nyid phyir na sngags rgyal gyi/ /sems kyi rdo rje bskul ba yis/ /zab mo'i rnam pa rnyed ldan pa'i/ /phyed par dka' ba'i dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po snang ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje can chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas gnas ni rnam rdzogs dang / /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sgrub dang / /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dgod pa dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi la sogs pa/ /rim pas rjes su bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mri ta swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu sti badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rta mchog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje nyi mas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba'i lus/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ges bskyed/ /des ni sangs rgyas gnas dgod bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /de yi steng du sangs rgyas bsam/ /spros nas gzhal yas gnas dgod bya/ /rdo rje lta bur mi phyed phyir/ /des na mi bskyod bsgom par bya/ /ma skyes rjes su dran pa las/ /rnam par snang mdzad phan pa nyid/ /rin chen rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /'di ni rin chen sems su bshad/ /rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ /'dod chags mtshan nyid 'dzin pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gnas 'dug pa'i/ /sems ni 'dod chags zhes byar bshad/ /gang phyir 'bras bral min sgrub ltar/ /de phyir don yod rab tu grags/ /rig ma mdzes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa las ni gsang pa'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /ji ltar lus ni de bzhin gshegs/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bris nas ni/ /dam tshig khu ba'i cho ga yis/ /hom dang bsam gtan bskyed byas nas/ /de tshe dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /mkha' 'gro lnga dang ldan pa dang /

/dam tshig lnga yis bkang pa dang / /mkha' 'gro lnga yi tshogs ldan pas/ /slob ma rdo rje can la bskur/ /rdo rje sa bon rab sbyor bas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyar nas/ /slob ma rtag par nges bsams te/ /rgyun gyis rigs kyi ming gis so/ /slob ma rdo rje can dbang bskur/ /spyan dang bdag ma sgrol ma dang / /dkar mo la sogs bdag gzugs kyis/ /rdo rje btsun mo rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje bla med bshad par bya/ /bla na med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gnyis su med cing yi ge med/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal byed/ /bde ba bzang po'i ro myang gis/ /sgrib pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //ga dang ha zhes bya ba dang / /dang po'i mthar yang sha ldan pa'i/ /rab tu gsal ba dam pa nyid/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /cho gas rdo rje bdud rtsi myang / /'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni gzi brjid lus po che/ /'jig rten kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phas kyi rgol ba kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten kun gyi bdag pos brgyan/ /lha rnams kyi ni 'dren pas rjed/ /mkha' 'gro lnga'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chos kyi zas ni za ba po/ /dam tshig chen po'i bsam gtan zos pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //mi bskyod brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /rtag pas chu shel chen por ldan/ /rdo rje nyi mas rgas pa med/ /don yod rgyal po chen po ni/ /rdo rje srog gis yan lag 'byung / /don kun bsgrub cing dpal dang ldan/ /des na rnal 'byor par ni brjod/ /mi bskyod btung pa'i sbyor ba las/ /stong phrag lngar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phan pa yis ni khri ru brjod/ /rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje'i 'bum/ /tshe dpag med kyis dpag med dang / /bdun gyis nam mkha' ji srid bshad/

/rdo rje nyi ma dpag med dang / /'khor ba'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba gnyis/ /'di dag bsten pas rnal 'byor pas/ /kun tu bzang po 'dra bar 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ye shes/ /'di ni rdo rje nyi mar brjod/ /chos rnams thams cad kyi ni thabs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can nyid kyi/ /thabs dang shes rab zhon pa dag /khams gsum dag ni thams cad du/ /sa dang sa 'og bar snang la/ /khrag dang khu bas khyab pa'i lus/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug gis 'di gsungs/ /sen mo ba spu de bzhin khams/ /khu ba la ni rnam par gzigs/ /lpags dang khrag la gzi brjid che/ /tshil dang rkang la rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rtsa dang sha la bdun rgyal po/ /'di rnams lnga ni sangs rgyas lngar/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros rnam par bshad/ /sa yi khams ni rnam dag pa/ /spyan ni 'khor lo mdzes pa nyid/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo dwangs pa ste/ /pad ma'i bu mo tsha ba nyid/ /sgrol ma rlung ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo bzhi rnams ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i/ /gur gyis de rnams bka' stsal to/ /sngags thams cad rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi lnga mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te le'u bdun pa'o// ༈ //khyod ni zhe sdang rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/ /thugs dag chos ni shin tu rnam dag pas/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag rgyan mdzad pa/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod/ /khyod ni gti mug rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/ /sku yi dag pa chos kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /mgon po ri khrod ma ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod/ /khyod ni 'dod chags rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/

/gsung dag legs par so sor rtogs pa yis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /gtum par ldan pa bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad yongs skyong ba/ /gzugs kun nan tan thams cad mnyam nyid kyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /ḍoṃ bhi bdag la mgon po myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod/ /thams cad bzhengs par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //'khor lo can rnams thams cad kyi/ /'dis ni bskyed par 'gyur bar ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag pos de skad gsungs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhu tsa ri badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā tā la wa si ni badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /byin brlabs gnas su rtag par ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag rgya chen po rab sbyor bas/ /sku yi rin chen sbyang par bya/ /bsam gtan rdo rje bsams nas ni/ /sems kyi rin chen rab sgrub byed/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /ngag gi rdo rje dri ma med/ /gti mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyang / /zhe sdang rdo rje'i bsam pa yis/ /sgra yi sgo yi bsam pa 'o/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje yis/ /ro drug 'dod chags rdo rje yis/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje yis/ /yid la kun tu bzang po yis/ /de nyid mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ /'di rnams kyis ni thams cad sbyang / /gal te 'gal ba yod pa ma yin yang /

/de tshe rgyal ba'i dngos pos sbyang pa yod/ /kun rdzob bden par yang dag gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis chos tsam rnam par bsgom/ /chos kyi dngos po ma byung spyad pa las/ /gang zag thams cad rnam spangs 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'gro ba bsam par mi nus te/ /chos kyi tshul gyis thams cad rnam par dag /tshig pa rnams kyis gdung dang dug khyab pa'i/ /lus kyi sman ni gzhan pa'i dug nyid de/ /ji ltar chu ni rna bar zhugs pa la/ /yang ni chu ni thabs su 'gyur ba nyid/ /ji ltar rlung gis dkrugs pa'i sems rnams kyi/ /de bzhin mkhas pas mon sran gre'u sbyin/ /'dod chags kyis kyang rmongs pa yi/ /skye bo 'dod chags me yis gdung / /'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod chags smad pas zad par 'gyur/ /'dod chags rdo rjer yongs shes pas/ /yid ni rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhags pas 'ching pa yis/ /'jig rten chags pas khyab par brjod/ /'dod chags bral bas mngon byang chub/ /'dod chags mthar phyin rnams mi 'dod/ /de nas rdo rje sgrol ma yi/ /sgrub thabs sbyin sreg las kyi ni/ /cho gas 'dod don thams cad ni/ /sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la 'di rnams ni sngags kyi rkang pa rnams yin te/ oṃ na mo ar+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bho dhi swa twā ya/ mahā swa twā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭan ma ma kri te dzaṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ sarba stam+bha ni tra ya swāhā/ ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar bsgom/ /gzhon nu ma yi mtshan nyid 'bar/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i dbang skyes pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi dbu rgyan can/ /lang tsho la ni bab pa'i lus/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/

/sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'od zer dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje zhags pas de bzhin dung / /g.yas pas mda' ni 'gengs pa 'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyus ut+pal gzhu/ /sdigs mdzub g.yon pas 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba yis/ /gnas gsum po ni bsgrub par bya/ /shar du me tog sgrol ma ste/ /kha dog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge oṃ las skyes pa mo/ /me tog phreng pas lag pa brgyan/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas su bdug spos sgrol ma ste/ /mdog nag mdzes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /spos dang dung gis lag pa brel/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub tu mar me sgrol ma ste/ /mar me sdong pos lag pa khyab/ /mdog ser rnam par rgyan chen mo/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /byang du dri yi sgrol ma ste/ /dri yi dung gis lag pa khyab/ /khrag gi mdog ltar lha mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor snying por bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu la sogs rab dbye bas/ /der ni sgo yi srung ma bsam/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma/ /'og tu snod mdzes ma rab bsgom/ /'khor lo klu zhags bsams nas ni/ /spro zhing sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ yi ge bcu yis lha mo bcu/ /pha rol phyin bcu la gnas ma/ /'bras bu thams cad rab grub phyir/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgom par bya/ /sngags 'di mchog dang phul du phyin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bklags pa grub byed drag po ste/ /rdo rje gur gyis bshad pa 'o/ /sngags 'dis gos kyi thu bar bdun mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ mdud pa bcings nas nags tshal du 'gro na yang sus kyang mi 'khyer te/ stag dang chom rkun dang / chu srin sna 'thung dang / seng ge dang / sbrul dang / mche ba can dang / ma he dang / dom dang / smyug glang la sogs pa ming dran pa tsam gyis nyams shing yib bo/

/sngags 'dis ut+pa la'i sbyin sreg ji srid du lan brgya rtsa brgyad ji tsam par bskyur bar bya ste/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu ke me wa sh+mamā na ya swāhā/ yang na sngags de nyid kyis khwa'i sgro la lan sum cu rtsa gnyis yongs su bzlas te/ dgra'i khyim du sbas na nyi ma bdun gyis skrod par byed do/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shi gh+ra ga mi nī de wa tat+ta u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas gzhan yang sbyor 'gyur ba/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā/ bhi dha na ku ma ri ma h+ya murbā he na ta s+ya bi tā pra ya ts+tsha tu me swāhā/ spra tshil dang gtum pa'i sa bon dang / myos byed dang / a sho ka'i lo ma dang / me tog bsreg blugs bya zhing / mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bu ram du bcas pa stong phrag lnga'i sbyin bsreg ni bu mo'i dngos grub la rab tu bsngags te/ nyi ma bdun gyis de'i tshe rnal 'byor pas rang 'dod pa'i bu mo 'thob bo/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā bhi dha naṃswa s+d+ya nā ta a kar+ṣa ya ma man+ta ke dzaḥ sngags 'dis 'ba' dha ra'i tsher ma stong phrag lnga rang 'byung gi me tog dang / bsreg blugs bya bar brjod pa 'di byas pas/ skyes pa skyong pa rnams kyi bu mo yang 'gugs par byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la bcom ldan 'das ma phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma/ lag pa lcags kyu dang ut+pa la dang zhags par bcas pa rnam par bris ste/ de'i mdun du mchod pa byas na/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing legs zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas/ phyi nas bsgom pa dang ldan par sngags bzlas bya'o/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā ma ma i bi taṃ sa p+naṃ kā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ stong phrag lngas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pas mgrin par bcings te/ lcags kyus drangs nas bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsams te khol mo'i tshul gyis bza' bar bya'o/

/de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags par byas te/ bdag gi mig gnyis mig sman gyis bsku bar bya zhing / rgyal po'i rigs kyi drung du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po slob ma dang 'dra bar gus par byed cing 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / bka' drin stsol cing snyan par brjod pa byed pa dang / bran du yang dag par 'gro zhing khros pa yang dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni mngon sum du mthong ba ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur sgrol ma'i gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te kha gnyis pa'i so dug thal bar byas nas/ ba kha dog dmar mo'i mar dang / a rkaka'i shing bal las sdong bu rab tu sbar la/ mig sman bsdu bar bya'o/ /mig sman de rdo rje nyi ma dang / rdo rje chos dag dang mnyes la/ rta mchog gis bdug par bya'o/ /thal ba dang lhan cig mig bsku bar bya ste/ rdo rje mig gis gang bltas pa de gal te pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug mi 'bab na/ de'i tshe bdag sgrol ma ma lags te/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bkrongs pa lags so/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ byis pa so med pa'i lce blangs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas nas/ bung ba'i rgyal po'i rtsa ba dang ba lang gi gi wang lhan cig byas pas dpral bar thig le yongs su bzung ste/ gang bltas pa de dbang du byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ lto ba'i srin bu la gzungs bdun du mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ rdo rje chos dang lhan cig so rtsi byas la bu mo la byin te/ 'byor pa mchog zos pa na mi spong pa dang / gzhan du mi dga' ba dang / gzhan du mi 'gro ba dang / rang gi bdag po yang spong ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ mar khu chen po nye bar byugs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlas la bsgom par bya'o/

/bzlas pa'i mthar sa lu btags pas lde gu'i dri ma la khur ba byas te gang la byin pa de lnga por yang mi spong ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla ba la nye bar chags pa'i dus su sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlos shing brten par byas la/ de las byung pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug blangs te/ dung gi thal ba dang mnye bar bya zhing / rab tu grags ma nyid la byin te ji srid du lngar yang rjes su 'brang ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i gzungs kyis ma da na pha la la lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu des rta mgrin dang lhan cig pas bskus na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re/ a mu ka s+ya ban+dhaṃ mu tī ku ru mu swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis arkaka'i lo ma la bsgrub bya'i ming nang du chud par bris la/ ne'u le'i khung bur sbas na bcings pa las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'byung gnas yang dag par rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcad par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma mdog dkar ba yid 'phrog ma skra phyed du li ba/ chu skyes shin tu dkar ba la yang dag par gnas ma/ lag pa g.yas par pad ma mdog dkar ba yang dag par bsgoms shing / g.yon na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje skyil krung du gnas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan ma lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ las skyes ma mchog tu dga' bar byed ma/ dam tshig sems ma bskyed nas ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya zhing / rnal 'byor zla ba drug tu goms pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo bdun du sbyor bas bstan bcos thams cad shes par byed do/ /'bum bzlas pa'i sbyor bas nyi ma re re la tshigs bcad brgya byed par 'gyur ro/

/rab tu 'bad pa med par gzhung brgya yang 'dzin par byed do/ /de la sngags kyi rkang par 'gyur ba/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dzñā bar+dhā ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha bar+d+da ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bhu dha bar+d+da ni swāhā/ khwa mi zer ba na sngags bdun du mngon par bsngags pa byas te/ ma bslangs pa'i sings po skyur po la lan bdun du sngags kyis btab par bya zhing / ji srid zla ba drug tu gang 'thung ba de shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag bshad par bya/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sngags/ /sgrub pa po yis nges par 'grub/ /dal zhing zab mo'i chos dang ldan/ /rig pa thams cad mkhas par bcas/ /sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing / /rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son/ /de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa bsrung pa po/ /sngags spyod rim par gus pa dang / /gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang / /dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing bzlas par ldan/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'joms pa po/ /sngags dang lus skyob sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten rnams ni bde bar byed/ /de ldan bla mar byas nas ni/ /gang zhig bla ma smod byed cing / /skye bo bla ma smod pa gang / /dmyal ba chen por 'tshed par 'gyur/ /ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dang por mchod/ /rdo rje gur gyis 'gro ba yis/ /de ltar bla ma'i nan tan bya/ /bla ma'i grib ma bud med dang / /lham dang stan dang mal stan rnams/ /rmongs chen gang gis 'gom byed pa/ /skyes pa de ni pu gri 'dzin/ /legs par dbang bskur slob ma gang / /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' byed pa/ /'jig rten 'dir ni 'on par 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol dmyal bar gnas/ /g.yo dang rgyu yi sbyor ba yis/ /brdzun gyis mi nus smra ba la/ /khom skam mdze nad chen po can/ /dmyal ba la sogs skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes pa'i slob ma yis/

/bla ma'i bsnyen bskur pha rol 'gro/ /bla ma'i bka' ni rab bsrungs na/ /dngos grub rgyas pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi zas ni rtag tu bya/ /zhi ba la sogs rtag tu bskul/ /snga bar dge 'dun chos ston bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kyang mnyes bya/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul zhing / /de yi rjes su tshogs kun la'o/ /bdag gi las ni brtsams nas ni/ /cho ga 'dis ni bsgrub par bya/ /yan lag rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor gtor ma btang / /me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /de bzhin dri yi dung sogs g.yas/ /g.yon du sngags kyi mchod yon snod/ /mdun du snod ni gzhag par bya/ /zhabs bsil gong ma'i cho ga yis/ /me tog spos sogs rim pa bzhin/ /la s+ye la sogs mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa byas na bzang po sbyin/ /me tog bskyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / /dri ni 'thor ba'i tshul gyis dang / /sdong po mar me'i mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i lugs kyi rjes su dris/ /la s+ye'i lag pas la s+ye ste/ /phreng pas phreng pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gis glu yi dam tshig glu/ /brla bskums pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di ni bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par gyur/ /bzlas dang bsgom la mngon dga' zhing / /rtag tu 'khor lo'i pha rol 'gro/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' ji bzhin/ /'di rnams bla med mchod pa 'o/ /me tog spos sogs mngon sum du/ /'jig rten spyod par gnas pa yis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa mchog nyid min/ /de nyid byang chub yan lag min/ /dkar po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /ser po rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs la/ /dbang dang dgug par dmar po che/ /tha ma'i las la nag po 'o/ /zhi ba la ni me tog dkar/ /ser po rgyas pa'i rdo rje la/

/me tog nag po tha ma la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dmar po bzang / /rnal 'byor pa gang dbang bskur med/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /gang zhig rab gnas ma mthong dang / /gang zhig sbyin sreg ma byas pa/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /de yi dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab/ /'dir ni rigs su skye ba med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bya/ /gang gis byang chub ma thob na/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i gnas su de'i/ /skye zhing skye bar skye bar 'gyur/ /yang na sa yi bdag po nyid/ /dag pa'i gnas su mngon par 'gro/ /bde ba can dang mkha' grong dang / /dga' ldan du ni blo ldan skye/ /'jig rten 'dir ni gang 'grub pa/ /sangs rgyas de ni smos ci dgos/ /khams gsum bdag po chen po nyid/ /'chi med rgas pas khyab pa med/ /tshangs pa brgya byin de bzhin drag /sgra gcan me dang rlung dang ni/ /'dod pa'i lha dang thong ldan nyid/ /'di rnams de yi 'khor du 'gyur/ /lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha ma yin dang mi/ /mi 'am ci dang mkha' spyod rnams/ /de rnams 'khor 'gyur the tsom med/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rigs dang byang chub byed pa dang / /de bzhin du ni lhar gshegs dang / /khyim nas 'byung bar byed pa dang / /rab tu byung pa 'dzin pa dang / /skye ba yongs su len pa dang / /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa ston/ /'dul ba'i 'jig rten mthong nas ni/ /'di ni gzugs ni du ma byed/ /sangs rgyas sems can bskyab bzhed pas/ /sangs rgyas gar ni rol pa mdzad/ /ri bong stag dang seng ge dang / /glang po rnams kyi rigs su yang / /snying rjes phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /phyag rgyas grub pa skye bar 'gyur/ /bud med sgyu ma'i spros pa yis/ /'dod chags can la chos gsung ngo / /bud med sgyu ma sangs rgyas nyid/ /sgyu ma thams cad sel bar byed/

/shes rab pha rol phyin gzugs su/ /bud med rtag tu yang dag gnas/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i gnas 'dug nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu ster/ /g.yo zhing dad che ngo tsha med/ /rtag tu 'dod chags pha rol 'gro/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'dug nas/ /dngos grub kyang ni rab tu ster/ /gzugs dang yon tan nor la yang / /'dod pa gang yang btsun mo med/ /rdo rjer 'dod chags yid 'dod pas/ /rang gi bde ba myang bar ldan/ /skyes bu tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /bde gshegs bka' las mi 'da' zhing / /bla ma bsnyen bskur snying rje can/ /kyai rdo rjes rab phye ba'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma gtso mo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rjes bdag la stsol/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po dang / /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dam tshig la gnas te dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ thig skud sar pa mdzes par ldan/ /shin tu tshad ma gtsang ma yis/ /he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bya/ /de la 'di ni slob ma chen po'i gsol ba gdab pa'i dam tshig go /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje la gsol ba gdab pa rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje yis ni gsal ba'i lus/ /sku gsum las ni skyes pa spro/ /gal te la la 'da' byed na/ /'jig par 'di la the tsom med/ /lus srul po dang kha cig gang /
