/bde chen ye shes byung pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin skyes/ /zur cig bgegs ni chen po rnams/ /'khor lo yi ni brgyad nyid kyi/ /cha yis sgo ni rab tu grags/ /sgo khang lha yi snam bu ni/ /sgo yi tshad kyis tshad du bya/ /sgo yi phyed kyi cha ru ni/ /ya phubs dang ni 'gram nyid do/ /mchod snam nyid kyang de bzhin bya/ /dra ba'i snam bu rig byed phyed/ /dang por tshangs pa'i thig dang ni/ /gnyis par mtshams kyi thig dang yang / /gsum par ngos bzhi yi ni bzhi/ /thig ni rab tu gdab par bya/ /tshangs thig cha gnyis bor nas ni/ /cha drug tu ni gdab par bya/ /de nas sgo yi tshad bor nas/ /dgu yi char ni rab tu gdab/ /de la 'di ni sbyang pa'i dam tshig go /oṃ khaṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ de la 'di ni ye shes spyan drang pa ste/ oṃ me di ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ de la 'di ni thig gdab pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ de la 'di ni rdul tshon bri ba'i dam tshig ste/ 'di ni chos dbyings gdab pa ste/ /sems can khams ni thar par byed/ /kyai rdo rje rgyal po ches/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ /dbang ldan du ni sha ra bha/ /me yi mtshams su dge sbyong bri/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bden bral du/ /rlung du rdo rje bri bar bya/ /shar du lcags kyu bri bar bya/ /lho yi sgor ni zhags pa nyid/ /nub sgor de bzhin lcags sgrogs te/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu 'o/ /dbus su thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos sbyin sreg gi grong khyer rab tu phye ba/ rdo rje thab khung sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i sreg rdzas sbyor ba las/ /zlum po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /rgyas pa ra ba'i rdzing bu gzugs/ /dbang ni zla ba phyed pa 'dra/ /dgug pa la ni lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /gsad dang zhe sdang las la ni/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa 'o/

/de bzhin skrod byed skal ngan dang / /yan lag g.yo ba'i sbyor ba las/ /tsan dan a ka ru shing dang / /gzhan yang dri yi rkang 'thung nyid/ /sbyin sreg yan lag mes sbar nas/ /phyis ni yang ni gug par bya/ /oṃ ā+e h+yi mahā bhu ta de ba ri shwi twi dza sa man ta gri hi twāṃ a hu ti mahā na ma asmin+sa ni hi to bha ba/ lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug par bya/ /zhags pa nyid kyis gzhug bya zhing / /lcags sgrog gis ni zhabs dag bcing / /dril bu 'khrol bas dbang du bya/ /la s+ye la sogs mchod brgyad dang / /mchod yon sna tshogs byas nas ni/ /mar la sogs pa'i sbyor ba las/ /yang ni me ni mnyes par bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje mchod yon gyi dam tshig ste/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā ra pra ti ts+tsha swāhā/ de la 'di ni zhabs bsil gyi dam tshig ste/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da hā na badz+ra ya badz+ra swa twā s+ya sarba pa paṃ da ha na swāhā/ de la 'di ni bsreg rdzas thams cad 'chu ba'i dam tshig gi sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dz+wa la ya/ sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭ/ drī sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya satwaṃ haṃ/ phyi nas rang 'dod pa'i lha spyan drangs pa ste/ oṃ e he h+yi wa ga wan+ni ha bh+ya kabh+ya na sa ma ye na tsa a gan+haṃ/ sam+p+ra tits+tsha taṃ pu dzā ñtsa dwa pra si da me/ de la 'di ni dgyes par byed pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ kri ti wa sarba sa twā ar+tha sid+dhi dha t+ta ya tha a nu ga gats+tsha dhaṃ bud+dha bi ṣa yaṃ pu na ra ga ma na ya muḥ bzhengs pa dang las sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba dang / sbyin sreg gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rab gnas ni/ /'jig rten tha snyad la gnas te/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan par bya/ /dang por re zhig rig ma 'dzin/ /dril bu 'khrol bar 'dod pa dang / /rkang g.yas rkyang pa'i sbyor ba las/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba dang / /srod thun skad ni chag pa dang /

/gos kyis mgrin pa bcings pa dang / /rin chen sman gyis yongs gang pa'i/ /bum pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ mo ha ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ dwe shwa ra ti a ti tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ ra ga ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ 'di ni ye shes dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /shun pa lnga dang ba yu lnga/ /khyad par du yang dri lnga dang / /lus can la ni blugs pa dang / /mchod yon lnga ni sngon bzhin bya/ /yang ni de nyid sbyor bar bya/ /snga bar blugs shing byin gyis brlab/ /mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /dbang ni rang gi rigs nyid kyis/ /mchod pa la sogs rim pas brtsam/ /rang snying gnas su ye shes bsam/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs par bsang gtor bya/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /rim pas mchod pa'i lha mo spro/ /byang chub sems mchog bsams nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bstod pa yang dag brtsam/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /stong pa snying rje tha dad med/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun bsgrubs shing / /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje 'phen mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i yid kyis dgyes/ /rdo rje se gol sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje bsgom pas bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje yi ge blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje phung por rnam par bsgom/ /de nas rdo rje 'tshed pa bsam/ /rdo rje lce yi sbyor ba las/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i rjes bcug nyid/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis bsang gtor bya/

/bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje bdud rtsi ro myang pa'i rdo rje de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son par/ /rtse mo lnga pa bris pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /stobs kyis sangs rgyas phur bus gdab/ /chos 'byung grong khyer yid 'ong bar/ /rdo rje mdzub mo'i sbyor ba las/ /gal te dngos grub mi ster na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang gsad par bya/ /oṃ du ru du ru/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phur bus gdab pa chen po rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rta mgrin rnam par bsgom par bya/ /dbu rgyan la ni rdo rje chos/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /pad ma dmar po spyi bor 'dzin/ /sku mdog dmar po stobs po che/ /gos dkar gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ /dang po dmar po shes par bya/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /rdo rje chos ni gzi brjid che/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa po/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje rnam snang dran par bya/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje 'dzin pa bsam/ /sku mdog dmar po gzi brjid che/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad dang / /zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po/ /chos kyi 'khor lo spyi bor 'dzin/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /spyan dang gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /dang po'i zhal ni dkar po ste/ /nag po dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje nyi ma rnam par bsgom/ /cod pan rin chen 'dzin par bsam/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od chen po/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po/

/sems kyi rin chen spyi bor 'dzin/ /btso ma gser ltar gzi brjid che/ /dang po'i zhal ni ser po ste/ /g.yas pa sngon po 'dra ba 'o/ /g.yon pa zla 'od bzang po ste/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rta mchog rnam par bsgom par bya/ /dbu rgyan ral gri 'dzin pa bsam/ /margad ut+pal mtshungs pa 'o/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni sngo bsang ste/ /rta yi gzugs te 'jigs pa po/ /g.yas pa kha dog nag po ste/ /g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ /ral gri dngos grub spyi bor 'dzin/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /rdo rje nyi ma rta nyid kyi/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sgrol ma'i gzugs/ /lha mo rnams ni phyag gnyis brjod/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa nyid/ /kye rdo rje la dkyil 'khor mchog /phan par me long de bzhin no/ /rta mgrin la ni gos bzang ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma la ni gser/ /rta mchog nyid la 'gro mgyogs te/ /mchog tu phan pa nyid kyi yon/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /bla ma la rtag rgyun du dbul/ /skal bzang rdo rje sems dpa' bdag /skal bzang thub pa rnam snang mdzad/ /skal bzang dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang / /skal bzang nyi ma bdun rgyal po/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin pa pos/ mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig gi mchog gsungs pa/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ ma d+dha ma d+dha/ badz+ra dh+rig phaṭ swāhā/ de nas sngags chen bshad pa na/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje'i dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mgrin gyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya staṃ/ hu lu hu lu/ a ro li ka phaṭ swāhā/

de nas 'di ni bshad tsam na/ /rdo rje chos ni grags chen po/ /'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /chos kyi dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ phan pa'i sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ swā shwā ta pa ra ma swā shwā ta e h+ye hi dzi na dzig phaṭ swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang de bzhin gshegs/ /brgyal zhing 'jigs par gyur nas ni/ /de rnams sangs rgyas dngos grub stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen nyi ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra sur+ya ta mo bi dha ma ha sa ma ya satwaṃ haṃ rat+na dh+rika phaṭ swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od chen po/ /'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mchog rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /phuḥ phuḥ phuḥ hi hi hi/ pra dzña dh+rika phaṭ swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje don yod rigs 'byung ba/ /'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /de rnams don yod dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dkyil nyid de/ /rdo rje can gyi zla phyed mtshungs/ /rdo rje chos kyi pad ma 'dra/ /nyi ma yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /rta mchog zhes bya de yi ni/ /thams cad du ni gru gsum mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /phan pa'i phyag rgya nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya che/ /rin chen tog gi 'od byed ma/ /don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya che/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par ldan/ /stag gi pags pa bsnams pa dang / /dbu skrar thod pa phyed pa ste/ /mchod par brtson pa'i sems pa yis/

/chags pas mig dmar mthong nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /chags pa'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis/ /spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /rdo rje spyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje phyag rgya yang dag brtsam/ /me tog 'bras sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /nags tshal chen po'i mtha' nyid du/ /sems dpa' chen po 'gro bar bya/ /nags tshal du ni slong mos rgyu/ /zas ni bzang pos brgyan pa nyid/ /de rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas ster/ /nags tshal bdag po'i rigs kun ni/ /rdo rje can de'i 'khor du 'gyur/ skyes pa dang ni skye ba kun/ /skye bo gang zhig skye 'gyur ba/ /gti mug rdo rje'i sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /khams gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /sgra ni gang zhig rab grags pa/ /rna ba'i drung na gnas pa bzhin/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i sbyor ba las/ /drang srong mngon par shes pas thos/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /mtshon dka' lta bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra lnga bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sems kyis shes par 'gyur/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /rang gis rigs ni stong phrag gcig /rdo rje sbyor bas dran 'gyur te/ /nyi ma gsum bzhin dran par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba du ma yis/ /'dis ni snang bar byed par 'gyur/ /mngon shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// ༈ //phan pa nyid kyis zhi ba ste/ /rdo rje nyi mas rgyas pa 'o/ /rdo rje chos kyis dbang zhes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas gsad par bya/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /dbang ni yang dag brtsam par bya/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /rdo rje char sprin rab bsgom bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/

/bu mo bkug nas bza' bar bya/ /me'i char sprin 'bab pa dang / /gdug pa'i sems kyis gsad par bya/ /'phrog pa las ni dkar mo ste/ /skye gnyis pa las tshangs ma nyid/ /dpal ni sred med bu las kyang / /ma bcag pa las ram bha nyid/ /marga chu srin rgyal mtshan las/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /de rnams thams cad nye bar bza'/ /shin tu dga' ba'i sems kyis brtse/ /'dod pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthar ni swa hās zhi ba ste/ /rgyas pa'i dus su bho ṣa ṭa/ /mthar ni hūm̐ phaṭ gsad pa la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dza dang hri/ /las thams cad pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab grub phyir/ /thub pas tshig 'di bka' stsal to/ /me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa dang / /ri khrod dang ni sman ljongs su/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mchod par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab grub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas grub par shog /tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ /sems kyi ngal ni gso bar bya/ /phyi nas byang chub sems gnas te/ /de rjes bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /bden dang brdzun par dpyad pa yis/ /brtags pas nye bar mi gos te/ /ma skyes pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'dir ni rab tu brjod/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/

/hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo bcu ni rim pas dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes rab mthar/ /pad ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /ḍa ki khro bo dbyug pa sngon/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen dang / /gtsug tor gdugs ni dkar po dang / /rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa ni/ /bdud rtsi'i sbyor bas thams cad du/ /khro bo'i bsgom pas bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad brgya ni khyab pa ru/ /bsams nas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yang ni chu ni bsgom par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dbang chen bsgom/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /bh+rūm̐ las gnas ni bsams nas su/ /rnam pa lnga ni rab brtag bya/ /ye shes lnga las byung pa yi/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /rig ma'i skyes bu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ dharma dha tu swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje bzhengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mig la sogs pa gti mug sogs/ rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mkha' spyod ma/ /gsung gi rdo rje sa spyod ma/ /sku la zhabs 'og gnas ma ste/ /hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ las byung pa 'o/ /rdo rje dkar mo chu bdag ma/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i gnas mnan cing / /dkyil 'khor snying por bsgom par bya/ /dkar mo chom rkun ro langs ma/ /ghasma ri ni sgo srung ma/ /pu k+ka si dang ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa g.yung mo mtshams su dgod/ /steng du mkha' spyod ma zhes bshad/ /'og tu de bzhin sa spyod ma/ /dbus su bdag med mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom/

/byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar chen po'i che bstsal ba/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung pa stsol bar mdzad/ /ye shes kyi dbang la gsol ba gdab pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rig ma'i skyes bu dbang chen la/ /cod pan rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /des ni dkyil 'khor dbang dang ni/ /bstod dang mchod pa la sogs bya/ /ye shes gzhug pa de bzhin yang / /lce yis rdo rje bdud rtsi myang / /nang du brjod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /brtul zhugs can gyis sngags bzlas bya/ /rnal 'byor ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang rang gi rnam par rtog pa skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces spyad par bgyi/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs/ /rnal 'byor ma zhes mngon par brjod/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /gang phyir de nyid brten pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ces bshad/ /pha rol phyin pa kun gyi thabs/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dga' mdzes mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mtsho/ /mkha' dang gser gyi char pa dang / /dga' chen ma dang ghasma ri/ /shin tu dgyes rol gsang yid 'phrog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phan rgyud brgyad/ /kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas kun/ /gsang mdzod rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba dang / /'khor lo sdom pa gur gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud drug tu rab tu grags/ /skyes bu rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni yang dag bshad/ /btsun mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/

/rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor gong mar de ltag la/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ re zhig bdag cag gis yul rnams ni 'tshal na/ sems can gzhan rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar gsungs pa 'tshal ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /stong pa snying rje tha dad med/ /gang du sems ni rab bsgoms pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa 'o/ /mu stegs can sun dbyung pa dang / /rgol ba tshar gcad pa dang / rang gi sde pa'i gzhung lugs brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //bdag gis byang chub thob phyir dang / /gang phyir gzhan dag bsgral ba'i phyir/ /des na sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa 'o/ /bdag 'dzin zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /chos dbyings bdag nyid sgrub thabs ni/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dus pa yis/ /des ni sangs rgyas bstan pa 'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / /rgyal ba'i sras po rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung 'di thos nas dga' bar gyur te tshig 'di smras pa/ e ma kun tu bzang po yi/ /bstan pa nam mkha' las byung ba/ /nam mkha'i gnas su sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyan par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /bde ba chen po rnams 'phel bas/ /dam tshig thams cad bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /bde dang rangs shing gar dang ni/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra byed pas/ /dri dang phreng pa byug pa yis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rab tu 'grub/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung na/ /ji ltar 'dod par spyad par bya/ /ji ltar gnas su gnas nas kyang / /yi ge dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /bza' dang btung ba'i sbyor ba dang / /bzang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /nyi ma gcig tu bskul ba yis/

/dam pa'i de nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu rang gis dam tshig myang / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /ji ltar mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rdo rje 'dzin bzhin bla ma nyid/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rgyal po che/ /ji ltar thub pa rdo rje chos/ /ji ltar mgon po bdun rgyal po/ /de ltar rdo rje slob dpon brjod/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che/ /dge ba mchog tu gsal ba po/ /nam yang smad par mi bya 'o/ /rdo rje sdom pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// ༈ //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po rdo rje gsor bar bzhed pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bdag med mas 'khyud pas/ bzang po spyod pa dbye bar bya/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su bzhag nas ni/ /ji ltar 'dod par 'dod pa yis/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur ba nyid/ /dogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /dri lnga yang dag blangs nas su/ /rdzas lnga dang ni bsre bar bya/ /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris nas ni/ /ri lu'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gur gum a ka ru ldan pa/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /ri lu kha ru bcug byas nas/ /nyi ma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sha lnga dang ni ldan pa ru/ /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris nas ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab sbyor bas/ /nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /tsan dan dmar po kha che dang / /dga' ba sbas pa sbyar ba ni/ /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris byas pa/ /rta yi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams bsgoms nas/ /tsa na'i rus pa'i tshad tsam las/ /gu gul lcags kyis dkris pa ni/ /mgon po'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ri lu'i sgrub thabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //klu'i rgyal po'i mgo bsregs nas/ /rang byung khrag gis bsgo bar bya/ /rdo rje phan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mig sman rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/

/ba bla'i sa bon ldan pa dang / /stag gi pags pa'i tshil bu mnye/ /sku yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rkang pa'i byug pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /yan lag med pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /dbang po'i brag phug 'gram du ni/ /rdo rje rkang 'og rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha yi bu mo rab bsgrub bya/ /o d+yan yul du nye ba na/ /a mra chen po'i ri la ni/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes sbyor ba yis/ /rkang 'og rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang nas yang du bskul bar bya/ /de nyid dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mtshungs/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes sku chen po/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa can/ /sdigs mdzub klu yi zhags pa can/ /kha dog nag po bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje mdzod ni blangs nas ni/ /rnam pa thams cad bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod pa yis yang dag mnan/ /phu zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod do/ /rab tu byug pa dang mig sman rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung thos nas/ dga' zhing mgu ba skyes par gyur te/ tshig 'di skad smras so/ /e ma'o rdo rje e rdo rje/ /e ma'o rdo rje'i bstan pa ni/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la/ /gang phyir dngos grub rab gnas pa/ /snying po med pa'i chu shing la/ /ji ltar snying po 'bras zhim pa/ /de ltar snying po med lus la/ /dngos grub 'bras zhim de bzhin no/ /nam mkha' 'byung po thams cad dang / /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /sems ni nam mkha' lta bur dag /dag pa'i sems ni mchog tu bde/ /don dang dbang po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sems las phyi rol gyur pa med/ /gzugs sogs so sor 'dod pa yis/ /sems nyid du ni 'dod pa bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji ltar na sems stong la/

sems las phyi rol gyi sems mi stong pa rab tu 'byung zhes bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ thog med srid pa'i bag chags kyis/ /phyi rol don ni rnam par brtags/ /sems kyis thams cad rnam par brtags/ /sems ni kun tu 'gro bar brjod/ /byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'byung ba bstan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ /sih+la ga pur 'byung pa'i gnas/ /pang du gzhag par byas nas ni/ /skra nas bzung pa yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje 'o yis 'o bya zhing / /rdo rje mnyed pas mnye bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khyud pas yang dag blang / /rdo rje ma mchu rab btsir bya/ /rdo rje mdzub mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje gnas ni rab bskul bya/ /rdo rje sems ni phyung bas ni/ /rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya/ /phyi nas de yi bde can du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzhug par bya/ /rdo rje 'ching ba'i rim pa yis/ /rdo rje mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byung pa la/ /sems ni brtul zhugs can gyis 'phrog /pad ma me tog ldan pa yi/ /pad ma dmar pos mchod par bya/ /pad mas mnyes pa'i rdo rje can/ /pad ma dmar pos khyad par du 'o/ /dri lnga'i rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /rgyal mtshan ga pur mchod pa ni/ /'dis ni brtson 'grus bde chen dang / /stobs dang rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / /mthong ba nyid kyis bskul ba yis/ /'jig rten 'di ni dbang du byed/ /gang gis dkon mchog gsum bsad dang / /gang gis sems can zad byas dang / /gang gis slob dpon smod pa dang / /sangs rgyas lam la 'phya ba rnams/ /lcags kyu yis ni yang dag dgug /lcags sgrog gis ni rkang pa bcing / /zhags pas mgrin pa dam par bcing / /rdo rje bdag gis dgug par bya/ /mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas bsams nas ni/ /de rnams dpang por gsol bar bya/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bkrongs pa ste/

/'di de sdig pa chen po can/ /mnar med 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ /'di ni dmyal ba chen por ltung / /de ltar bsams nas gsad par bya/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni bsams nas su/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje dbyug pas brdung byas na/ /rdo rje can gyi gnas su skye/ /lcags kyu la sogs mi nus na/ /zan gyis kyang ni 'du bya zhing / /de nyid kyi ni gzugs bsams nas/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor nyid du gzhag /ṭa k+ki'i rgyal po'i lcags kyu ste/ /dbyug sngon can la rang gi ming / /stobs kyi rgyal po'i rtse gsum pa/ /rnam par rtog pa chen po gsod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /thams cad dbugs dbyung rab stsol bas/ /dam tshig rdo rje bsrung don du/ /sbas pa'i spyod yul 'di gsungs pa/ /rdo rje khro bo skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying khar mnan pa'i khu tshur mdzub/ /g.yas na rang gi mtshon cha 'phyar/ /gshin rje gsod pa'i dbyug tho ste/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje dbyug /rta mgrin la ni dbang mchog dmar/ /mi phyed bdud rtsi thabs sbyor la/ /ṭa k+ki'i rgyal po'i lcags kyu ste/ /dbyug sngon can la rang gi ming / /stobs kyi rgyal po'i rtse gsum pa/ /mi g.yo yi ge dkyil 'khor rtse/ /tsha skyob dkar po rgyal po la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /gtun shing rdo rje rkang 'og la/ /zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas gnas pa po/ /dbang po sngon po'i rnam pa ltar/ /mthar byed rnam par bsgom par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje ni/ /'jigs byed zla ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /pad ma'i khro bo dmar po che/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid gnag /mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzin/ /gshin rje rnam snang nyid kyis te/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbyug pa can/ /pad ma'i khro bo rnam gzigs rjes/

/rdo rje sems dpas thabs sbyor la/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje nyi ma bsgom par bya/ /'og tu pad ma'i gdan bsams nas/ /khro bo bcu rnams rab bsgom bya/ /ye shes rdo rje rang dbus su/ /bcu phyed dkyil 'khor bdag nyid de/ /bdud rnams zhabs kyi 'og bsams nas/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po bsgom par bya/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo gzi brjid che/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /'khor zhing rab tu mi g.yo bar/ /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam mo/ /bsrung pa'i dam tshig stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas bcom ldan dpal chen po/ /rang gi byin brlabs rim gnas te/ /rang gi byin brlabs rnal 'byor gyis/ /de nyid las ni bshad par bya/ /snying gi dbus su zla bar gyur/ /gzugs brnyan zla bar ma bcom pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag khyab/ /de las rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje bdag med mkha' 'gro ma/ /cho gas bskul bas bsgom par bya/ /mkha' 'gro'i sna yi mthar gnas pa/ /nyungs dkar tsam du rnam par bsgom/ /nyungs dkar la ni 'gro ba kun/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /de ltar sgom par byed pa yi/ /rang gi byin brlabs rab tu 'grub/ /gzugs sgra de bzhin dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya mngon 'dod pa/ /der ni rnal 'byor nyid kyis ni/ /mi 'dzin de phyir bdag gzhan med/ /ji ltar rdor pad las byung ba/ /zhi ba'i bde ba'i rnam par 'dod/ /rba rlabs med cing snang ba med/ /rnam rtog med cing yi ge med/ /myos byed cung zad rab 'thungs pa'i/ /bdag nyid bdag gis mi rig go /dga' bral dga' ba dag gi mthar/ /rtog pa'i dra ba rnam par spangs/ /'gyur med 'khrul pa las 'das shing / /kyai rdo rje'i rnam par gsal/ /bem min rnam pa he ru ka /rnam pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /rang nyid mgon po he ru ka /de yis bdag nyid mi rig cing /

/de yi dus na thams cad rig /'byung po'i 'gro dang 'ong ba ni/ /rang gis kun mkhyen lta bur gzigs/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras po dang / /yan lag kun dang bu ga kun/ /mgo bo'i dra ba skud par bcas/ /lus ni yod min ltar gzigs shing / /skad cig kye rdo rje gzugs 'dzin/ /ji ltar nam mkha' mi dmigs shing / /mtshan ma med cing ma byung dang / /gos pa med cing 'khrul pa med/ /sgrib pa lnga ni rnam par spangs/ /ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan ni/ /rtogs nas bden pa rnam spangs pa/ /de bzhin bdag nyid he ru ka'i/ /rnam pa lta bur gsal bar mthong / /de nyid don dang dbang po dang / /phung po nam mkha' lta bur yod/ /lus ni bden pa nyid brjod cing / /'du byed rnams kyis zil gyis gnon/ /gzugs ni mig gis mi 'dzin te/ /sgra ni thos pa po yis min/ /lce yis ro ni mi tshor te/ /dri ni sna yis kyang ma yin/ /reg bya lus kyi gong bus min/ /'on kyang bde chen tshul las ni/ /bud med bzang mo rig pas bde/ /rna ba glu yi bde ba bzang / /snom pa dri yi bde ba che/ /skye gnas reg pa bde chen dang / /ro yi btung ba'i sbyor ba las/ /gang gis bde ba 'gog par byed/ /bde ba chen pos 'gro ba khyab/ /bde ba ma rtogs mi shes so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang btsun mo bzang / /sangs rgyas lnga dang du ma ni/ /bde bar phyin cing rnam par sad/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi bde ba chen po'i tshig thos nas tshig 'di dag smras pa/ phal pa'i rnam pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa yang ni bsgom pa min/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rtogs pa de bzhin te/ 'on kyang mi gtsang pa'i tshad mnyam par sbyang pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bsgom par bya'o/

/phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lus can bsgom pa'i thabs kyi dgos pa de nyid ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang pa'i bdag po dgos pa yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas nyid do/ /sangs rgyas nyid de ci lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de ci lags/ lus can 'di ni bden pa'o/ /de rgyu ci'i slad du zhe na/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ 'di ltar nga ni mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan cing / dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus brgyan pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ mi 'dra ba'i phyir bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das bem po lags sam/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ nga nyid me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes de ci lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bden pa ma yin pa dang / brdzun pa ma yin pa dang / rgyu ma yin pa dang / skye ba ma yin pa dang / de ltar nga nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / nga nyid so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes dang / nga nyid bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes dang / de ltar chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnam pa dang bral ba'i byang chub de skad ma smra zhig nga nyid dngos po dngos med dang / /dang por de bzhin gshegs par brjod/ /gzugs dang gzugs med ldan pa'i mchog /zab mo zhi ba'i gzugs dang ldan/ /sems dpa' chen po he ru ka /bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor nga / /bde chen las ni bem min nga / /'jig rten kun rdzob bem po nga / /skyes pa bud med ma ning nga / /'gro ba nga yis yang dag khyab/ /de phyir 'dus pa zhes bya nyid/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshor bdag gis bshad/ /rdo rje can dang byang sems rnams/ /ma ning gnas su yang dag grub/ /gang zhig lha mo bdag ma de/ /rang bzhin gyis ni btsun mo min/

/sangs rgyas he ru ka nga min/ /de nyid phyir na ma ning ste/ /'gro ba dngos po gnyis mthong nas/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid nga / /shin tu mnyam sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /mi bskyod med cing bdag ma'ang med/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'dod pa bde ba chen po/ rdo rje yan lag med pa shin tu dga' chen pos tshig 'di skad bka' stsal pa/ phyag bzhi pa dang sgeg par bcas/ /zhal gcig ral pa 'dzin pa dang / /brgyad gnyis lo dang ser po ni/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa bsgrub/ /dpa' bo'i g.yas par mda' nyid de/ /lag pa gnyis par ral gri nyid/ /gsum par me long rig par bya/ /lag pa g.yon par gzhu nyid de/ /gnyis pa la ni dbang mchog nyid/ /kaṃ ke la yi yal ga ste/ /phyag drug nyid du bsgom par bya/ /zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas gnas pa ni/ /'dod pa'i sngags ni ma bcom pas/ /bu mo'i snying khar bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje btsun mo 'grub par 'gyur/ /mda' yis 'o ma 'dzin pa 'bigs/ /a sho ka yis snying khar brab/ /ral gris skyes ma bsdig par bya/ /de nas me long bstan par bya/ /gzhu yis rkang pa bcings nas ni/ /ut+pal zhags pas dgug par bya/ /gang 'dod rnam par rol bsams te/ /skra grol 'ong par 'dod pa dang / /snyan pa'i skad ni rab tu smra/ /ha dang si ni byed pa mo/ /rangs shing yan lag tsher mas brgyan/ /kha ni sor rtsis bkang pa dang / /'dod pa stobs dang bral ba bsam/ /rdo rje mchod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mi 'gyur sems kyis rjes chags bya/ /de yi snying ni bskul bar bya/ /oṃ a mu kī ā kar+ṣa ya mañdzu gho ṣa hriḥdzaḥ de ltar sgom pa byas pa yis/ /'jam pa'i mgon po'i btsun mo ni/ /sgrub pa po la 'dod pa dang / /dbang du byed cing 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bzlas pa khri yi sbyor ba las/

/g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /shin tu dga' ba'i sems kyis sgrub/ /haṃ gi sa bon las skyes pa/ /thams cad rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /chang gi btung ba'i rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa bsgrub/ /ma bcom mchog gi sa bon ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin can/ /bde ba chen po mchog tu zhi/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di ni srog ni chen po ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba mdzes pa nyid/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rtag tu de'i/ /dran pa de ltar rab tu grags/ /mya ngan 'dod chags de bzhin gdungs/ /dga' dang dga' bral de bzhin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /de nyid dbyangs yig drug pa brjod/ /zla ba phyed pas yang dag ldan/ /thig les mgo bo nyid du brjod/ /sems can rnams kyi kun gzhi ste/ /rgyud rnams kyi ni khyad par du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po rdo rje sa bon gyi yi ge thos nas/ sems gsal ba sgrub pa nye bar gyur nas tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/ sems dpa' med cing sgom pa med/ /sngags med lha yang med pa ste/ /sems kyi rdo rje las byung ba/ /'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bsod nams med cing sdig pa'ang med/ /byang chub med cing sangs rgyas med/ /ye shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /byang chub sems 'di brtan pa 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sngags med bzlas pa'ang yod ma yin/ /'gro ba gsum po thams cad med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /sgom pa dang ni bsgom pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun rdzob 'jig rten pa yang yod/ /dpyad na gang du 'jig rten pa/ /rtag tu 'jig rten pa nyid 'khor/

/'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das pad ma'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ma skyes pa dang mi dmigs pas/ /mi phyed nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /zab cing zhi ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ral gri'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sgyu ma ji ltar me long ltar/ /nam mkha' ji ltar me long ltar/ /nam mkha' ji ltar bde ji ltar/ /ji ltar dngos po yongs shes pa/ /'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma bdag med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /stong nyid dri med dam pa'i gnas/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid/ /ji srid ma zhig bar du ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bsgom par gyis/ /mā ma ki yi'o/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di de bde chen rdo rje ste/ /gang zhig yid kyis sgom pas bsgom/ /de ni mchog gi bsgom pas bsgom/ /spyan gyi'o/ /sngags dang yi ge rnam par spangs/ /de ni sems med thig le med/ /'di de dam pa'i bde chen te/ /bri ba med cing gang ba med/ /gos dkar mo'i 'o/ /gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ji lta bar/ /de ltar dngos po bsgom par bya/ /stong nyid dri med mchog gi gnas/ /der ni bsod nams sdig pa med/ /sgrol ma yi'o/ /ji ltar chu nang zla ba de/ /bden min brdzun pa min pa ltar/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /lus kyi rang bzhin rnyog pa med/ /'khor thams cad kyis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sna tshogs byed pa rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te mda' gzhu'i char 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mu ts+tshu ṭi dang seng rna yis/ /'chang zungs khu tshur bzung ba yis/ /gzhu ni 'dod pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /bsdams pas dgra rnams bsdig par bya/ /yan lag kos skor bzung nas ni/

/mtshon char khu tshur bzung nas ni/ /hūm̐ gis mda' ni gtang bya zhing / /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor bsdig par bya/ /brla ni bskum par byas nas ni/ /lus ni dbugs kyis dgang par bya/ /rna ltag khu tshur bzung nas ni/ /brang ni rgyas pa nyid du bya/ /sems dang mig ni 'ben la bya/ /hūm̐ gis kha ni dgang par bya/ /g.yas brkyang la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /gshin rje srin po gsad par bya/ /'dir mang brjod pas ci zhig bya/ /kun rdzob tu ni bsdus pa tsam/ /gzhu yi rig byed brtse ba gang / /de ni rdo rje 'dzin spyod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rol mo'i sgra zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rol mo'i sgra'i sgeg pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /tha hi tha hi/ tha ka tha ka tha tha tha tha/ tha ho tha ho/ ba hiṃ ba hiṃ/ u ṭ+ṭaṃ u ṭ+ṭaṃ/ kraṃ ka kraṃ ka tha ka tha ka hi dhiṃ hi dhiṃ/ ta ḍa wa ta ta ḍa wa ta/ cha lang ma tsa rnga dang yang / /rdza rnga kha cig pi wang rgyas/ /mngar ba can dang gling bu dang / /rgyud gsum ka ra ṭa ka ni/ /rnam gsum brdung par brdung par bya/ /chu ngur brdungs pas brgyal ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor gsol gdab la sogs pa/ /mchod pa 'di ni bla na med/ /rang gi tshigs bcad mang por ni/ /bstan pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya/ /ji snyed rol mo'i bstan bcos su/ /de ni rdo rje'i rol mo'i sgra/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dri bzang po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bdug spos kyi mchod pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /tsan dan nyid dang gur gum dang / /brag zhun de bzhin 'dod ma ni/ /'di rnams rdzas ni bdug spos che/ /he ru ka la rab tu dbul/ /ka tso ra dang kun ma dang / /de bzhin du yang skra sgra nyid/ /bdug byed snying po 'di rnams ni/ /phan pa la ni sbyar bar bya/ /kun tu ru dang bo la ka/

/ri dwags lte ba sen mo ni/ /rin chen rgyal po'i bdug pa 'di/ /kun la mi 'jigs gu ram dang / /sha thi dri yi sha thī dang / /sha li dza dang shi la ka/ /'jig rten mgon gyi bdug pa 'di/ /rtag tu rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs/ /sna tshogs dri ni khyad par du/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i mchod pa las/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i mchod pa 'di/ /kun gyi stobs kyis bsgrub pa ste/ /ji snyed dri yi bstan bcos su/ /gong bu'i dum bu'i bdug pa mchog /de kun phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje'i mchod pa rab tu grags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gom pa rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje gar 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gus bcas dang por sgeg par ldan/ /dang po rtsed bcas rjes rgyu bas/ /rkang stabs brgyad du cho ga yis/ /rdo rje goms pas rol pa bya/ /me tog snyim pa'i sbyor ba dang / /spos kyi yal ga'i sbyor ba dang / /mar me'i sdong po lag tshul dang / /yang ni byug pa'i lugs dang ni/ /mig lag de bzhin brla nang dang / /rkang pa'i 'og tu bskor ba ni/ /brdungs pa'i sbyor bas rol pas bya/ /de bzhin du yang g.yon pas so/ /de nas rgyun gyi gar byas nas/ /g.yon pas yang ni gar bya zhing / /myur du brdungs pas de bzhin gar/ /byas nas 'khor lo lta bur bskor/ /phyi nas gru bzhir dgang par bya/ /phyi nas 'dod pa'i lag pas bskor/ /sa la pus ni gnyis btsugs nas/ /lag pas mchod rten legs par bya/ /ji snyed gar gyi bstan bcos su/ /byed pa'i cha lugs brjod pa ni/ /de snyed rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sgeg pas byang chub bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje mnyes par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo /

/rang gi lhag pa'i lhar dmigs nas/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /thams cad 'byor pa dmigs nas ni/ /bem po'i gnas su bsreg blug bya/ /shar lho byang dang ngag phyogs dang / /phyogs gnas rnams ni dga' bar bya/ /phyogs bral gnas su lha mo rnams/ /dam pa'i tshe yis mchod par bya/ /yid kyis mar khu bsams pa dang / /'bras so chag med 'bras dang ni/ /'bru dang zho yi zan dang ni/ /til dang de bzhin mnyam pa'i shing / /dūr bar rab tu bzhon pa nyid/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes sbyin sreg bya/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi rkang pa yin te/ oṃ ag na ye swāhā/ mar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye badz+ra swa twā s+ya sarba pa paṃ da ha na swāhā/ til nag po'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pus ṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras ma chag pa yi'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zho dang zan dam pa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bī dza ya swāhā/ 'bras so ba yi'o/ /oṃ mahā be ga ya swāhā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ mahā ba lā ya swāhā/ mon sran gre'u yi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swāhā/ gro'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a yu she swāhā/ dūrba gzhon nu'i 'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhā/ ku sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dza ya swāhā/ u dum ba ra yi'o/ /oṃ bo dhibri k+ṣa ya swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra la ta ya swāhā/ pa la k+ṣa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ku be ra ya swāhā/ na gro dha yi'o/ /oṃ ha sa ka ra ya swāhā/ a mra yi'o/ /tsam pa a sho ka yang klu/ /ka ngam wa dang srid sgrub nyid/ /ji ltar snyed pa bzlas byas nas/ /me tog 'dis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /rgun 'brum a mra sbrul 'jig dang / /kha 'dzag skyes ma rtse ma ni/ /'khor lo lnga yi chog rim pas/ /'bras bu rnams kyi sbyin sreg bya/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi nyid/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi sgom pa yis/ /'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par 'gyur/ /ye shes me ni rab dgyes bya/ /rgyal ba phan pa mnyes pa dang / /gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang /

/pad ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang / /lcags mchog bdag po mnyes pa dang / /tshangs pa brgya byin dbang chen dang / /khyab 'jug rlung dang me chen dang / /thong ldan ldan nyid dang 'dod lha dang / /zla ba nyi ma gdon gzhan dang / /sa ni zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / /lus ngan de bzhin mtshams skyong dang / /chos rgyal dang ni klu dang ni/ /dri za lha min mi 'am ci/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa'i lha/ /'og min du ni gnas pa dang / /gang zhig rgyal chen gnas pa dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang bsgyur nyid dang ni/ /'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang / /gang zhig dag pa'i gnas son dang / /'od zer 'jig rten khams gnas dang / /mi mjed khams su gnas pa dang / /gling gzhir gnas pa'i sems can dang / /gang zhig khams gsum gnas pa dang / /snod ldan sems can 'jig rten dang / /lcug ma'i tshogs dang rtsa sogs dang / /gang zhig rab dga'i sar gnas dang / /pha rol dri med gang phyin dang / /'od 'phro can du gnas pa dang / /mi g.yo'i gnas su byas pa dang / /gang zhig chos sprin rjes song dang / /gang zhig sbyang dkar son pa dang / /gang zhig ring song thob pa dang / /'od byed du ni gnas pa ste/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po dang / /'phags pa gang zag brgyad po dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos nyid/ /rwa ni ral gri'i gzugs can dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /sbyin sreg cho gas dgyes pa nyid/ /de bzhin tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rgya mtsho rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dam tshig la gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa ni/ /rdo rje pad ma'i bsgom pa ste/ /de yi bgo ba'i sna rtse la/ /phyag 'tshal yid bzhin nor bu ste/

/sbu gu'i nang du phaṭ kyis ni/ /ye shes ma lhung yang dag gnas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dgyes par brjod/ /'dis ni phyag rgya'i cho ga las/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpar snyems byas nas/ /gnas ni thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'dug nas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bdag /shākya seng ge bsnyems byas nas/ /rgyal po thams cad 'thob par 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i gnas 'dug nas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bdag /rdo rje'i gzi brjid ting 'dzin ldan/ /dam tshig phyag rgya sbyor ba yis/ /gnas gsum po yang bsgrub par bya/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug bdag /chos kyi phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje chos ni bsgom par bya/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /rta mchog rim par gnas nas ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar sbyor ba yis/ /sgrol ma'i dngos grub rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gar 'dod pa byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rdo rje'i gar mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /g.yon brkyang ba dang g.yas brkyang ba dang / mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang / rdo rje'i rkang stabs dang / dkyil 'khor dang / sna tshogs thams cad dang / ru sbal gyi rkang stabs dang / bung pa'i dra ba dang / rgya mtsho'i bskyod pa dang / ri bo'i mchog dang / mdzes pa'i gom pa dang / khro bo'i gom pa dang / rkang stabs kyi dgod pa'o/ /ral gri'i lugs dang / 'khor lo'i tshul dang / rin po che'i tshul dang / pad ma'i lag pa dang / ral gri tshul dang / mdung gi tshul dang / gzhu'i mda' 'phen pa'i tshul dang / dbyug pa'i tshul dang / dbyug to'i tshul dang / gtun shing gi tshul dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i tshul dang / kha bcu pa'i tshul dang / ral gri'i bu mo'i tshul lo/ /sna tshogs dbyug pa'i tshul dang /

mdung thung gi tshul dang / gong bu skyong pa'i tshul dang / 'phan gnyis pa dang / 'phan lce gsum pa dang / me tog gi tshul dang / bdug spos kyi tshul dang / mar me'i tshul dang / dri'i tshul dang / lā s+ye'i lag pa dang / phreng ba'i lag pa dang / glu'i lag pa dang / gar gyi lag pa dang / gling bu'i lag pa dang / pi waṃ gi lag pa dang / rdza rnga'i lag pa dang / ku mu ta'i lag pa ste lag pa'i dgod pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung dang / pad ma skyil krung dang / pad ma'i 'dug stangs dang / bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang / skyil krung phyed pa dang / bkra shis kyi 'dug stangs te/ 'dug stangs kyi dgod pa'o/ /sgeg pa'i ro dang / dpa' bo'i ro dang / mi sdug pa'i ro dang / rgod pa'i ro dang / drag po'i ro dang / 'jigs su rung pa'i ro dang / zhi ba'i ro dang / rngam pa'i ro dang / snying rje'i ro'o/ /drug gi rjes su skyes pa'i glu dang / drang srong gi rjes kyi glu dang / dri za'i rjes kyi glu dang / bar ma'i rjes kyi glu dang / lnga pa'i rjes kyi glu dang / blo gsal gyi rjes kyi glu dang / 'khor nyan pa'i glu'o/ /nyung ngu'i dbye ba dang / sgrol ma'i dbye ba dang / 'jigs pa'i dbye ba dang / gang ba dang / phyed phyi ba dang / rnam par 'dre ba dang / 'dod chags gnyis mtshungs par byed pa dang / 'dod chags gsum mtshungs par byed pa dang / lkog ma mnyed pa dang / rkan mnyed pa dang / lce mnyed pa dang / so mnyed pa ste/ glu'i dgod pa 'o/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus su ni/ /dam tshig 'di ni rab bskul ba/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni dam tshig rim pa'i mchog /me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /tshal bdag ro yi phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/

/dges shing mun pa rnam sel ba/ bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṃ ḍai a/ dril bu blang pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje gzung pa'i sngags so/ /dngos po sna tshogs rnam par phye ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang sangs rgyas la/ /tshig ni 'di dag bka' stsal pa/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /rdo rje las skyes rang bzhin can/ /lag par rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ kha/ /bsams nas spro zhing bzlas pa'o/ /phyag bzhi pa ni nyid dang yang / /zhal gsum rdo rje las byung ba/ /dkar po dmar po de bzhin sngo/ /phag mo lhan cig mnyam sbyor ba'o/ /phyag drug pa la kha dog gnag /lcags sgrog ma dang lhan cig sbyor/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi thod pa can/ /zhal gsum nyid du sbyor bar bya/ /mdog dmar phyag ni bzhi pa dang / /zhal gcig pa dang dbang byed ma/ /rdo rje chos kyi gnas mnan pa/ /'di ni ku ru kul+ler brjod/ /'di yi sngags ni brjod pa 'o/ /btsun mo'i chos la gnas pa ni/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar bdag gis ni/ /dus gcig pa yi dus su ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni 'di thos nas/ /rgyas pa nyid du rab tu dbye/ /lta stangs dgug dang brda chen dang / /don byed nus dang char sogs so/ /lam gyi de nyid las skyes pa/ /thub pa chen po 'jig rten mgon/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /mchod sbyin dang ni pad mas brgyan/ /pad ma'i gdan la yang dag gnas/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje chos dang ldan/ /maṃ gyi de nyid las skyes pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni ser po ste/ /yan lag mchog sbyin ut+pal brgyan/ /mi bskyod rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las byung ba/

/lag par ral gri sdigs mdzub nyid/ /ma he chen po'i rgyab tu ni/ /dpa' bo g.yon brkyangs pa yis gnas/ /khro bo'i gzugs can 'jigs byed de/ /kha sbyar mdun du mi bskyod 'dzin/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje can/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag pa gnyis kyis phyag rgya 'ching / /rkang pa g.yon nyid brkyangs pa yis/ /'jigs byed mnan pa yi ni lus/ /spyi bor rdo rje rigs bsams nas/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal dran par bya/ /taṃ gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /mchod sbyin dbang mchog mtshon cha ste/ /lha mo ljang khu lta bu nyid/ /rtag tu bzang po'i 'dug stangs gnas/ /sna tshogs pad mar yang dag gnas/ /spyi bor don yod 'dzin pa mo/ /sgeg mo chen mo skal bzang ma/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /maṃ gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /mchog sbyin a sho ka 'dzin ma/ /nyi ma shar ba lta bu ste/ /rnam snang dpal ni spyi bor skyes/ /g.yon brkyangs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /'gro mgyogs mdun gyi shing rta mnan/ /yan lag sgeg pa'i ro yis brgyan/ /'od zer can ni bsgom par bya/ /tsuṃ gi yi ge las byung ba/ /ston ka'i zla ba lta bu'i 'od/ /snying khar rin chen snyim pas gnas/ /mdzes pa'i tshul gyis yang dag bzhugs/ /lha mo sna tshogs pad gdan can/ /phan pas mgo bo mnan pa ste/ /byang chub sems ni 'dzag 'bab pa'i/ /lha mo stobs dang bral bas bsgom/ /baṃ gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /nor 'dzin shin tu kha dog ser/ /lag pas mchod sbyin 'bras snye ma/ /rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba las/ /yan lag rin chen 'byung gnas brgyan/ /spyan ni shin tu sgeg par ni/ /gnod sbyin rgyal mo bsgom par bya/ /nor gyi bdag po mtshungs par 'gyur/ /dzaṃ gi yi ge las byung ba/ /nam mkha' mdzod ces bya ba bsgom/ /kha dog ser zhing g.yas pa na/ /mchog sbyin rin chen ne'u ste/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rdo rje yis/

/spyi bo'i dkyil 'khor rnam par brgyan/ /rin chen char ni bsam par bya/ /skyor gang rdo rje chur gzhug bya/ /praṃ gyi yi ge las skyes pa/ /lus ni dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /lha mo ral gri 'khor lo 'dzin/ /spyi bor phan pas mnan pa 'o/ /rang gi mang po'i dus lta bur/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su yang dag gnas/ /nam mkha'i gnas nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'byung bar rnam par bsam par bya// ༈ //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sngags sna tshogs nang du chud pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags kyi tshogs 'di gsal bar mdzad pa/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ maṃ dzu badz+ra ya muḥswāhā/ oṃ hri ṣ+ṭi wi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ oṃ ma ri ts+yā+ai swāhā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun de swāhā/ oṃ ba su da re mahā ba su bri ṣ+ṭhi ba su dha re mahā ba su bri ṣ+ṭhi ni pa ta ni ba su swāhā/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ 'jig rten mgon gyis nad rnams zhi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis blo gros ngan/ /gshin rje gshed kyis yi dwags bsrung / /lha dang lha min hūm̐ mdzad kyis/ /sgrol mas 'jig rten dbang du byed/ /'od zer can gyis chom rkun 'jig /tsun das sems can thams cad ni/ /dgug pa yi ni cho gar brjod/ /dzaṃ bha la dang nor sbyin dang / /nor gyi bsgrub pa'i thabs su 'dod/ /bud med gang zhig bu shi bas/ /so so 'brang ma rtag dran bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa yi/ /sngags kyi rkang pas thams cad 'grub/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyis sbyor ba yis/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /snying gi bde ba bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo /

/hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa/ /phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gcig ldan/ /kha dog gnag cing cher 'bar ba/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa po/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche ba chen pos 'jigs par byed/ /gzugs thung gzi brjid chen po nyid/ /kha nas khrag ni 'dzag pa ste/ /slob dpon la rtag gang sdang dang / /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum khro dang / /sems can du ma gsod byed pa/ /nag po chen pos za bar byed/ /rang gi lag g.yas sha gcod byed/ /khrag gi rgyun ni 'thung par byed/ /de nas spyi bor 'di 'dug nas/ /de ni til tsam gcod par byed/ /mon sran gre'u dang 'dzam bu 'di/ /me tog bdug pa byug pa chang / /sha lnga nyid dang bdud rtsi yis/ /nag po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /sngags ni/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya shā sa na u pa ha ri ni e ṣā a pa tsi mahā ka lā+o a ya i daṃ tad rat+na tra ya ya a pa ka ri ṇaṃ ya di pra ti dzñaṃ sma ra si ta dā i daṃ duṣ+ṭa kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra mā ra gh+rih+ṇa gri h+ṇa ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na/ da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ tsha ba gsum gyi gzugs brnyan ni/ /byas nas lus la tsher mas dgang / /dug dang ske sogs kyis bris nas/ /de ni gang gi ming gis ni/ /de nas me la gdung par bya/ /de yi dus na mi snang 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub bsgom pa nyid/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub dngos grub che/ /dngos grub kun gyi spyod yul min/ /de'i dus de yi lus thob cing / /skad cig na ni bde chen tshul/ /skad cig na ni de 'khor ldan/ /bsgom pa dang ni sngags nyid dang / /skad cig sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /spyan gyis phrag nas 'khyud pa 'o/ /skad cig la ni gnyis med ldan/ /dga' ba chen po mchog tu dga'/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal skad cig gis/ /mā ma ki dang bde ba sdom/ /rdo rje pad ma'i rtsa mchod pas/ /skad cig gis ni gnyis med ldan/

/rdo rje pad ma rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje gus pa'i pha rol son/ /rdo rje pad ma mchod bya zhing / /pad ma'i 'dod pa spang par bya/ /bdag nyid rang bdag bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje pad ma rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje'i bu mo cher grags pa/ /rdo rje nag po lta bus mchod/ /rang rig skyes bu bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje pad ma'i rtse mchod pas/ /bu mo de bzhin gshegs ma mchod/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don du mchod/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bsam/ /rdo rje pad ma'i rtse mchod pas/ /gdol pa chen po las byung ba/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don du mchod/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu sgrub pa rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gnyis kyi sbyor ba dang / /nyi ma gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / /de bzhin du ni nyi ma bzhi/ /nyi ma lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom med/ /me tog la sogs mchod byas nas/ /bsam gtan gnas su 'dug pa dang / /phyag rgya lhan cig zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje sbyor ba yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na/ /sbyor ba 'di ni yang dag brtsam/ /nyi ma shar ba'i dus su ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom med/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin las/ /chags chen ting 'dzin gnas nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub bya/ /shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //pad mar rdo rje can bcug nas/ /rang gi rig ma bdag mar bya/ /de dang lhan cig 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /mi yi phyag rgya blangs na ni/ /de la 'khor lo rab tu dbye/ /dri dang me tog mthun byas nas/ /'khor lo goms par yang dag brtsam/ /spyan dang bdag ma sgrol ma dang / /dkar mo shin tu yid 'phrog ma/ /me tog dri yis 'thun byas nas/ /rdo rje mchod pa yang dag brtsam/

/sngags pas phan pa 'grub 'gyur zhing / /phyag na rdo rje 'grub pa dang / /rdo rje nyi ma 'grub pa dang / /dam pa'i yi ge 'grub pa dang / /bdun gyi rgyal po 'grub pa dang / /thams cad 'dren pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /chu yi dbang gis dang po ste/ /cod pan dbang la gnyis pa 'o/ /rdo rje'i dbang gis gsum pa ste/ /rang gi bdag po bzhi pa ste/ /ming gi dbang bskur lnga pa ste/ /drug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /bdun pa bum pa'i dbang gis te/ /gsang ba'i dbang gis brgyad pa ste/ /shes rab dbang gis dgu pa ste/ /de nyid rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /kun gyi de nyid brtul zhugs brjod/ /ston pa rang gis lung bstan te/ /de 'dir dbang gi cho ga 'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bder gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smod pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la gdug byams dang / /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /gzhan gyi chos la smad mi bya/ /bud med nyid la'ang smad mi bya/ /rtsa ba'i ltung pa rab tu spang pa mdor bstan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'ang smad mi bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bder gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya bcing pa rnam spang zhing / /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya zhing / /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/

/rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag pa ru ni bshad par bya/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzam bha la la chu sbyin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / pho nya mo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje nges par mchod pa 'di thos nas/ tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/ sems can kun gyis thams cad khyod/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su rtogs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdang pas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nga rgyal mnan pa 'gro gzigs nas/ /nga rgyal thams cad zad pa yi/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /'dod chags rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chags pas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /'dod chags thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /ser sna rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba phrag dog mnan gzigs nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /bdun gyi rgyal po rgyal po ste/ /thams cad gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/

/sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas dang / /rdo rje chos dang gzi brjid dang / /bdun gyi rgyal pos dngos grub rnams/ /gang phyir de yis dka' ba med/ /mig sman dang ni rkang byug dang / /ral gri rkang 'og bsgrub pa dang / /ri lu dang ni mkha' spyod dang / /mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /gang phyir ye shes rdo rje ni/ /mnyes pas myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir slob dpon drung gshegs te/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams phyag mdzad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bu'i/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs te/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi ni mthar dus su/ /shi ba 'jig rten mi gnas pa/ /skyes pa klen zhing rmongs pa gang / /de 'di shi zhes smra bar byed/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog gis/ /dag pa'i gnas su khyer bar byed/ /yang na bde ba can du nges/ /'dod pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /me tog sna tshogs lag thogs shing / /sna tshogs rgyal mtshan byug pa dang / /glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas sras dang rdo rjer bcas/ /sna tshogs sgra dang sil snyan che/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad sna tshogs dang / /dbang gi gnas rnams nyid kyis ni/ /lus las lus gzhan 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje dril bu lag byin te/ /mgo bo'i gtsug tor mnan nas ni/ /rdo rje sdom pa byin nas ni/ /bum pa'i dbang ni bskur nas ni/ /mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor bas/ /sbyang bar yang dag bstan pa 'o/ /nyi ma dag ni gsum pa na/ /rus pa'i phreng ba bsdu bar bya/ /'o ma dri bzang bsangs gtor nas/ /de yi mchod rten yang dag brtsam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/

thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de na/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yid rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brtags pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po gha ya dha rā dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 70 rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gur brtag pa gcig pa le'u bco lnga pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 69
